2024-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000249904.title: CUL.T. – Culture & Technology
2024-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000249904.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project hybridises technological and artistic-cultural knowledge by introducing a STEAM approach in the EU HEIs of technical-technological extraction, in response to the increasing pervasiveness of digital in the ways in which cultural assets are valorised and used, to foster the access of women from humanistic educational backgrounds to STEM study fields, increasing their employment chances in the labour market, that suffers from strong gender imbalances

<< Implementation >>

Co-design an HE STEAM CURRICULUM that hybridises culture and technology by activating operational synergies between academic centres and cultural organisations
Produce Microlearning Pills and Gamified Scenarios to inspire and guide the professional actions of women towards STEAM 
Produce a handbook on art-inspired coaching and work-based teaching that will be tested in vitro in a hybrid mobility by 22 lecturers/trainers
Test the HE STEAM curriculum with 60 females in HEIs from 5 EU countries

<< Results >>

An HE STEAM Curriculum implemented in the HE offering of IT, ES, FR, HR and AL
Microlearning pills and gamified scenarios to adapt students' skills to digital culture
An ART-INSPIRED TEACHING HANDBOOK to develop the creative potential of female students in designing game-based communication solutions for cultural assets
A Curriculum Pilot with 60 female students in 5 countries
A hybrid mobility for 22 lecturers/trainers for in-vitro testing of the Handbook
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2024-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000253039.title: Percezioni di inclusione, benessere e identificazione con l’Unione Europea negli Studenti Universitari Ucraini
2024-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000253039.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The General Objectives of the project Perceptions of inclusion, well-being and identification with the European Union in Ukrainian University Students are:
GO 1. to define a model of inclusion of Ukrainian students
GO 2. to promote the skills of university tutors and academic staff in promoting the inclusion of Ukrainian students
GO 3. to promote the development and adoption of common guidelines to promote the inclusion of Ukrainian students

<< Implementation >>

4 Transnational Project Meetings including at least 12 partners' experts (Suceava, Online, Istanbul, Padua)
1 International Online Congress with 50 participants
4 National Congresses in attendance with a total of 200 participants in Kiev, Suceava, Istanbul, Zagreb
1 International Congress in Padua with 80 participants and 13 partners' experts
1 piloting session of the online course for 120 Ukrainian tutors
1 validation session for 36 Ukrainian tutor-student dyads

<< Results >>

R1. An Operational Research Report of at least 100 pages and including commentary on the results of quantitative analyzes in a sample of at least 300 Ukrainian students
R2. Online Course for Tutors of Ukrainian Students is an e-learning platform aimed at increasing the skills of tutors of Ukrainian students in promoting well-being, performance and a sense of inclusion.
R3. Guidelines and Protocols for the inclusion of Ukrainian Students in Universities.

2024-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000256685.title: Supporting Ukraine's Next generation of scholars: a project for Raising university capacity and Improving doctoral Student Education
2024-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000256685.summary:
<< Objectives >>

SUNRISE addresses challenges faced by Ukrainian PhD students in environmental subjects due to the war. It develops the capacity of EU partners to provide relevant support in this sense. With 12 involved scholars from EU & 10 from Ukraine, SUNRISE aims to:
- build war-resistant and resilient learning infrastructure;
- support the war resilience and post-war recovery through curriculum contents reflecting the emerging challenges;
- ensure future academic competitiveness and research innovation.

<< Implementation >>

- Development of online ICT services for PhD training, leveraging on post-disaster experiences of UniCam & UniZg in the context of UN and EU strategies and directives;
- Co-development of research databases and curricula on post-war recovery & resilience, PhD (co-)supervision and expert advising/training support on emerging topics;
- Development of resilience guidelines for the post-war recovery and enhancement of academic activities in environmental research at partner campuses in Ukraine.

<< Results >>

- A suite of online services supporting PhD training, student work & learning progress (e-learning, e-science, e-portfolio), provided by UniCam & EMU;
- Curriculum, training tools & research datasets reflecting on war risks & impacts, and PhD research with possibility of (co-)supervision for Ukrainian students & supervisors;
- Resilience guidelines (Ukrainian-generic & campus-specific) and activities supporting post-war recovery, development of competitive environmental research and training.

2024-1-LT01-KA220-HED-000251565.title: AI Integration Framework for Higher Education: Ensuring HEIs' Readiness for Inescapable Transformation
2024-1-LT01-KA220-HED-000251565.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The aim of the project is to establish a holistic framework for integrating AI into higher education institutions (HEIs) with a strong emphasis on ethical considerations, capacity building, and adaptation. For HEIs there is no other way, but to recognize and prepare for the inevitable shift towards AI in academia.

<< Implementation >>

AI Framework for HEIs (Recommendations on implementing AI in line with the ethical principles in studies, research, and administrative services)
AI Audit process guidelines
Capacity-building activities for HEI staff (online training and tutorials)
Study module “AI literacy and ethics” (3ECTS) development 
Study module “AI literacy and ethics” piloting with students
Dissemination activities.

<< Results >>

Recommendations on implementing AI in line with the ethical principals
Policy and recommendations on using AI tools in studies in line with the ethical principals 
Policy and recommendations on using AI tools in Research
Toolkit on using AI tools in HEIs administrative services 
AI Audit process guidelines for HEIs
Trained researchers, teachers, and administration
7 HEIs approbated policies and procedures
3 ECTS study module “AI literacy and ethics”

2024-1-LV01-KA220-HED-000255929.title: Biomedical Innovations through Digital Transformation of Additive Technologies and Knowledge Exchange
2024-1-LV01-KA220-HED-000255929.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Respond to the demand of specialists caused by the introduction of disruptive technologies in medical device manufacturing under MDR Regulation (EU) 2017/745 by: 
O1: Incorporating Industry 4.0 (AR/VR, 3D Bioprinting, AI) in Biomedical Engineering curricula. 
O2: Adopting new digital teaching methods for transnational knowledge-exchange in the e-Metaverse. 
O3: Promoting personalized device manufacturing to encourage med-tech entrepreneurship. 
O4: Fostering collaboration across med-tech agents.

<< Implementation >>

For achieving the objectives, these actions will be carried out in close collaboration with industry partners:
A1: Generation of new e- contents in the biomedical field (e-courses, e-laboratories & e-case studies).
A2: Setting up an innovative digital learning framework under a dedicated metaverse platform.
A3: Testing new digital teaching methodologies for blended-mode education and summer schools.
A4: Promoting med-tech entrepreneurship through hackathons and multiplier events.

<< Results >>

R1: Metaverse platform with new contents: 8 e-book modules, 5 e-toolkit modules and 6 e-case studies.
R2: Organization of 3 Workshops for teacher and staff instruction in new methodologies.
R3: Organization of 3 Summer Schools students for personalized medical device manufacturing.
R4: Organization of 4 Hackathons for students and 4 multiplier events for all the agents involved.
R5: Students (116), Teachers (123) and Staff (38) mobilities for setting and testing the educational model proposed.

2024-1-MK01-KA220-HED-000251614.title: Reaching Beyond Borders: Enhancing Communication and English Proficiency in Veterinary Medicine Education
2024-1-MK01-KA220-HED-000251614.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The overall objective of this project is to enroll foreign students and produce high-quality professionals (Doctor of Veterinary Medicine) from the English program in non-English speaking Veterinary Medicine Faculties. This will be achieved by enhancing the curriculum, English language proficiency, and communication skills of teachers and administrative staff at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine in Skopje in partnership with Atlas Language School and the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine-Zagreb.

<< Implementation >>

The key activities of this project include a tailor-made curriculum for the English course and Communication Skills. Subsequently, training will be provided for the teaching and administrative staff at FVMS. The project continues with sharing experiences with Faculty with a similar program. This process will end with translation, adaptation, and digital transformation of teaching and administrative materials incorporated into the curriculum of the English Study Program at FVMS.

<< Results >>

The project results are a new, tailor-made curriculum for learning the English language for teachers and administrative staff working and enrolled in the English program at Veterinary Medicine Faculties; Trained teaching and administrative staff in topics-specific vocabulary in the English language; Improved curriculum of the English study program at the Faculties of Veterinary Medicine; and digital access to all administrative and learning materials in the English language for students at FVMS.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2024-1-MT01-KA220-HED-000246701.title: TRAINEE - Advanced MR Training foR HumAn-Centric ProductIon EmpoweriNg Engineering TalEnt
2024-1-MT01-KA220-HED-000246701.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The TRAINEE project aims to modernize HEI training by leveraging Mixed Reality (MR) technology for advanced learning experiences, promoting remote access to education for inclusivity, reducing environmental impact and infrastructure costs, and aligning with the EU's sustainability and digital innovation objectives. This initiative seeks to equip the current and future workforce with the skills needed for the high-tech manufacturing sector, demonstrating its commitment to the future of education.

<< Implementation >>

The project will execute a range of activities, including transnational meetings to bolster partner collaboration, the development of MR technology specs, curriculum, two case studies, a pedagogic framework, and tools for MR content creation and knowledge evaluation. These efforts aim to boost educational outcomes, accessibility, and inclusivity, minimize environmental impacts, and foster innovation, thereby enhancing the digital and green readiness of the European HEI sector.

<< Results >>

The TRAINEE project will deliver MR technology specs, curriculum, twp case studies, pedagogic and content creation frameworks, alongside a knowledge transfer evaluation tool. These results aim to innovate HEI education through enhanced MR technology use, making MR more accessible and versatile and improving learning personalization and effectiveness.

2024-1-NL01-KA220-HED-000248874.title: AI-HED - Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education Teaching and Learning
2024-1-NL01-KA220-HED-000248874.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The broader aim of AI-HED is to adjust the teaching and learning environments at our HEIs to the shifts caused by Artificial Intelligence (AI).

The general objectives of AI-HED are to:
Explore, test and conceptualise the impact of AI on teaching and learning
Enhance teachers skills, competences and attitudes to use AI in teaching and learning
Enhance students skills, competences and attitudes to use AI in learning
Develop recommendations for HEIs on integration of AI in teaching and learning

<< Implementation >>

During AI-HED the following main activities will be implemented:
A set of measures to enhance the AI literacy of lecturers (AI starter kit, training and Massive Open Online Course - MOOC)
Design, implementation and evaluation of 16 pilot courses which integrate AI in teaching and learning from different disciplines
Development of concluding recommendations on how to integrate AI in teaching and learning
A set of outreach activities to share the results with relevant stakeholders

<< Results >>

Main results/outcomes: 
Educational materials to improve the AI literacy among lecturers (starter kit, training materials and MOOC)
Guidelines on course development for lecturers who are integrating AI
16 newly designed pilot courses using AI in teaching and learning
Participation of 32 lecturers and 800 students in the course implementation
Compilation of best practices on use of AI in teaching and learning
Concluding recommendations on integration of AI in teaching and learning (white paper)
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2024-1-PL01-KA220-HED-000248249.title: Enhancing an evidence-based approach in business-oriented courses
2024-1-PL01-KA220-HED-000248249.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project objective is to enhance an evidence-based approach in business-oriented courses. To meet this aim Partners will attempt to satisfy the needs of both teachers and students in evidence-based teaching and learning in Partner institutions, as well as support teachers outside the Partnership once the project is over. Specifically, Partners will review current state-of-art literature and practices to equip teachers and students with new materials developed with evidence-based approach.

<< Implementation >>

Partners will interview academic teachers on their current practices, students on their perceptions and satisfaction with the teaching methods and review the literature to develop the guidelines for evidence-based approach in business-oriented courses. They will support teachers in redesigning their current syllabi and develop new materials for both teachers and students. Partners will conduct workshops at 12 HEI and set up EBT Centre to support teachers after project completion.

<< Results >>

The results of the project, accessible from the project website, include: A comparative report detailing how the in-class experience matches with the international literature; Lesson scenarios developed with evidence-based approach; Resource Pack for Teachers; Redesigned syllabi; Blended-learning courses with Syllabi and Guidelines for teachers; Workshop PPT presentations, conference presentations and articles; EBT Centre website.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2024-1-PT01-KA220-HED-000246374.title: Educational platform for ecological restoration techniques with artificial reefs in Natura 2000 sites.
2024-1-PT01-KA220-HED-000246374.summary:
<< Objectives >>

1.	To create a quality educational material about restoration with artificial reefs in Natura 2000 sites. 
2.	Comparison of European and national information about Reefs EU habitats, ecological restoration and artificial reefs. 
3.	Planning a training for integrating the mobility of the participants. 
4.	Establishment of learning outcomes on the use of artificial reefs for habitat restoration. 
5.	Creation of a transversal and innovative HE curricula. 
6.	To create an e-Learning platform.

<< Implementation >>

The activities to be implemented in RestReef are grouped into 5 work packages:
-	WP 1. Project management.
-	WP 2. Establishment of common learning outcomes on restoration of 1170-Reefs habitat using artificial reefs.
-	WP 3. e-Handbook for an educational approach for diving activities.
-	WP 4. e-Learning platform for restoration of 1170-Reefs habitat using artificial reefs.
-	WP 5. Pilot site courses of RestReef

<< Results >>

- Personal and professional development of the participants related to the thematic of the project and to contribute to their employability at EU level.
- Increase in the number of professionals who will use the e-Learning platform, creating a network of information.
- Awareness of the participants on the marine Natura 2000 sites and the environmental problems related to Reefs EU habitat.
- Integration of the curricula created in the universities, considering the potential outside of them.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2024-1-RO01-KA220-HED-000248845.title: Empowering Specialized Language Acquisition with Integrated AI
2024-1-RO01-KA220-HED-000248845.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to modernize FL acquisition through digital tools and AI integration, empowering practitioners with contemporary methods. Specifically targeting the ESP field, specialized in real-world skills, it seeks to support digital and sustainable initiatives in HE by enhancing capacity for digital transformation. Leveraging AI and data fosters effectiveness and relevance in FL education, especially in ESP. The foreign partnership, enriches the educational experience and ensures quality.

<< Implementation >>

The project starts by reviewing literature on AI integration in education, mainly in FL classes. It develops an AI solution database for ESP instruction, creates online educational resources, and implements AI tools across teaching, learning, and assessment levels. Then, it integrates AI into language acquisition methodologies, identifying best practices, developing training materials, and evaluating their impact on student outcomes. Workshops engage language specialists in novel approaches.

<< Results >>

The project aims to deliver major outcomes: a handbook on AI integration in FL/ESP education, a repository of AI solutions for ESP, an online lesson plan for AI in ESP language acquisition, 3 workshops for stakeholders in applied linguistics, 6 research articles, 3 observation sheet databases, 2 manuals for quality assurance and ethics, and a method guide on AI-enhanced language acquisition. These outputs advance AI integration in language education, promoting best practices among specialists.
topics: Teaching and learning of foreign languages

2024-1-RO01-KA220-HED-000254430.title: Electronic Health Literacy perspectives, education and digital tools
2024-1-RO01-KA220-HED-000254430.summary:
<< Objectives >>

- raising awareness about the importance of eHL in medical and allied health fields;
- determining the eHL skills of medical and allied health students in the eHL framework by applying self-assessment eHL instruments;
- improving the eHL skills of medical and allied health students by practicing different strategies and interventions for enhancing their eHL;
- providing eHL recommendations for policy decision-makers ;
- disseminating the results of this project, for a new approach of eHL.

<< Implementation >>

-  eHL Handbook, by using the expertise of the research staff involved in the project;
- eHL Web Platform, which will focus on the self-assessment of eHL and its predictor factors to increase eHL Knowledge and skills;  
- eHL Curriculum for students, which is designed to increase the eHL skills in a more practical approach;
- eHL Policy Toolkit includes recommendations for decision-makers in universities and policymakers at a societal level; 
- dissemination of the project's results.

<< Results >>

- increase knowledge about eHL and identify good practices in medical and allied health universities;
- eHL self-evaluation, understanding of available interventions or strategies to enhance eHL skills, improved access to eHL additional resources;
- focus on the practical aspects of eHL skills of students for their academic studies and in their future careers;
- increased eHL awareness, knowledge, and recommendations for decision-makers and policymakers to find Public Health solutions.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2024-1-SI01-KA220-HED-000252673.title: Teaching Artificial Intelligence
2024-1-SI01-KA220-HED-000252673.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Our project aims to revolutionize AI education by setting comprehensive ILOs, creating versatile databases, developing educational Python code, and launching an interactive MOOC. These steps are designed to standardize AI knowledge, enhance practical skills through experiential learning, and make AI education accessible and engaging. This multifaceted approach not only addresses the digital transformation in education but also promotes excellence and innovation in learning practices

<< Implementation >>

Our project will undertake key activities such as establishing clear ILOs for AI courses, gathering varied databases for experiential learning, crafting user-friendly Python code to demystify AI applications, and developing a comprehensive MOOC that combines traditional and modern teaching methodologies. These carefully planned steps are designed to elevate AI education, ensuring learners acquire essential knowledge and practical skills in a highly engaging and accessible manner.

<< Results >>

The project is set to deliver impactful outcomes, including the  creation of a versatile educational database, and development of accessible Python code tailored for AI instruction. Additionally, we will launch a comprehensive MOOC, blending traditional and digital learning to enhance AI education accessibility and engagement. These initiatives aim to elevate the quality of AI education, promote practical learning experiences, and significantly improve AI literacy among students.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2024-1-SK01-KA220-HED-000245367.title: E-Service Learning for Boosting Academic Civic Engagement in Rural Areas
2024-1-SK01-KA220-HED-000245367.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project’s objectives are: enhancing HE teachers' capacity for rural e-SL projects fostering civic engagement in students; promoting e-SL in rural communities to empower students for meaningful engagement; facilitating collaboration between universities, teachers, and rural partners through digitalization; ensuring sustainability of e-SL results for social inclusion, civic engagement, and prosperity.

<< Implementation >>

The project entails developing a training course for HE teachers to assist students in executing e-SL projects with rural community partners. Additionally, partners will design a tailored orientation course for HE students to enhance their civic engagement through e-SL experiences. Lastly, a matchmaking platform will be created to facilitate connections between teachers, students, and rural community partners.

<< Results >>

The project aims to facilitate effective e-service-learning (e-SL) initiatives in rural areas, including a training programs for HE teachers and a guide, a specific training for civic engagement of students and the creation of a user-friendly matchmaking platform, which will serve as a central hub for connecting HE institutions, teachers, and students with community organisations, fostering meaningful collaborations and empowering students to engage actively in civic endeavours.
topics: Tackling geographical remoteness and involving rural areas

2024-1-SK01-KA220-HED-000248287.title: Development and Reconstruction Empowerment through Advanced Project Management Education and Research
2024-1-SK01-KA220-HED-000248287.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims at the convergence of clean energy and digital innovation, introducing advanced project management courses (32 ECTS) for construction, engineering, and business students. It addresses the crucial gap in project management skills, vital for supporting Ukraine's post-war rebuilding and fostering global and European economic stability. Through interdisciplinary learning, it prepares students for real-world challenges, integrating digital and green skills.

<< Implementation >>

The project includes creating innovative project management programs (32 ECTS) for various fields, intensive training sessions for educators and students with a focus on practical skills, and the use of digital tools like Primavera for simulation and learning. It will host international workshops and conferences to promote collaboration, incorporate green practices for sustainability, and ensure continuous evaluation and dissemination of results for broad impact.

<< Results >>

The project aims to deliver a comprehensive PM curriculum enhancing digital and clean energy sectors' education, develop e-learning materials accessible across Europe, train faculty members, develop a "pedagogical guide" for diverse learning contexts. Expected outcomes include improved PM competencies among students, increased employability, strengthened EU-wide academic collaboration, and support for Ukraine's rebuilding through tailored training.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

hr.name: Zagreb School of economics and management

2024-1-SK01-KA220-HED-000255794.title: Implicit Anthropology of Reforms in Education
2024-1-SK01-KA220-HED-000255794.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to enhance the European Education Area by advancing understanding of educational reforms through interdisciplinary research, developing metrics aligned with European values, broadening participation in educational reform, and disseminating insights on the human aspect in education to strengthen democratic and cultural diversity across Europe.

<< Implementation >>

The project encompasses: a comprehensive literature review, development of an anthropological metric, conducting expert surveys and filmed interviews, compiling, publishing and refining an online reform database, presenting findings in an online course on educational reforms and a summer school for pedagogy students, communicating project results and findings in general news, articles, a white paper and an international conference, and additionally, by producing a documentary.

<< Results >>

The main project results include a report on the underlining (implicit) anthropology behind educational reforms in Europe in the past 30 years (based on literature review, a developed metric, expert survey and interviews), an online educational reform database, an online training course on educational reforms and policy, a summer school aimed at pedagogy and educational policy students, a white paper, international conference, 3 published articles and a documentary.

hr.name: Udruga za poticanje neformalnog obrazovanja, kritickog misljenja i filozofije u praksi Mala filozofija

2024-1-TR01-KA220-HED-000247730.title: Developing a digital-based curriculum of WAter footpriNT awareness in Mediterranean FISHeries for sustainable resources in Europe
2024-1-TR01-KA220-HED-000247730.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Water resources are essential for the proper functioning of ecological services and are undoubtedly crucial for the human and global economic well-being of all geographical regions of the world.The project accepts fisheries-based activities, which have already become industrial sectors, as one of the most important resources for human nutrition, leading to increased water consumption and the degradation of freshwater resources.WANTOFISH aims to create awareness of water footprint in EU fisheries

<< Implementation >>

The implementation activities will consist of four main elements. The first one will explain of state of the art-present status of the water footprint globally and European level in fishery and aquaculture. As the main point of the project proposal is reducing of water footprint by using our resources more effectively, a training methodology will be established accordingly. It will set up a curriculum development and finally, a guidebook on the methodology will be prepared and disseminated.

<< Results >>

Digital and visual educational materials will be presented on what water use is and how it can be reduced for fishing activities in the seas of the Mediterranean basin, which have different hydrographic and demographic characteristics from west to east. This information will be offered free of charge, especially to higher education institutions and all stakeholders, as a new curriculum. In this way, WANTOFISH academic solutions will be ensured to reach both target audiences in HED and also VET.
topics: Cooperation between educational institutions and business

2025-1-AT01-KA220-HED-000365381.title: Generative AI aiding in Product Development
2025-1-AT01-KA220-HED-000365381.summary:
<< Objectives >>

GenAID aims at providing mechanical engineering students with knowledge, abilities and skills for the proficient use of Generative AI tools, to formulate adequate prompts, evaluate the results of the interactions with AI and foster its ethical adoption in educational and professional contexts. At the same time the project will provide educators with methods, tools and educational materials to replicate the activities in other disciplines through project-based and learning-by-doing approaches.

<< Implementation >>

Over 3 years, GenAID will train 150 students from 5 leading European HEIs and equip them with skills to tackle real-world product development challenges through industry-driven projects and hands-on workshops. Project results and related materials will be showcased at exhibitions and collected in an open-access website populated with educational resources and ethical AI adoption strategies, to enable educators to benefit from a structured methodology to integrate GenAI into higher education.

<< Results >>

Year1: GenAID test and select Generative AI tools for NPD to collect in a knowledge base (PR1) and map the most suitable ones to specific NPD stages (PR2). Year2: the findings evolve into an educational methodology for HEI curricula integration (PR3) and specific prompt engineering guidelines that engineering design students can leverage for input refinement (PR4). Year3: finetuning via a framework for AI ethical use (PR5) and refined educational materials (PR6) for cross discipline adoption.
topics: Cooperation between educational institutions and business
New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-BE02-KA220-HED-000357830.title: Service-learning to promote Competences for Democratic Culture
2025-1-BE02-KA220-HED-000357830.summary:
<< Objectives >>

This project aims to deepen service-learning (SL) as a powerful pedagogical approach to foster competences for democratic culture in European higher education. Strengthening democratic life & enhancing democratic competences are key priorities for the EU & higher education plays a crucial role advancing these goals. We highlight SL as an innovative method to integrate civic education in the curriculum, empowering students, civic actors & institutions to actively contribute to democratic culture.

<< Implementation >>

-	Developing a framework on effective service-learning practices to foster learning outcomes linked to the EU Competences for Democratic Culture Framework (WP2);
-	Executing service-learning pilots to foster competences for democratic culture through art-based approaches (WP3) for information verification (WP4) and for bridging social divides (WP5);
-	Developing training materials on service-learning as an effective method for fostering competences for democratic culture (WP3-5).

<< Results >>

-	Report on service-learning practices to foster competences for democratic culture in higher education (WP2);
-	Training materials for higher education teachers on how to implement art-based approaches in service-learning practices which integrally foster competences in the 4 dimensions of the EU framework (WP3);
-	Training materials for HE teachers & community partners on how to develop & implement service-learning practices targeting the challenges of truth (WP4) and trust (WP5).

2025-1-BG01-KA220-HED-000363596.title: Cross-Disciplinary Innovative Education in Tourism and Services for a Sustainable Blue Economy
2025-1-BG01-KA220-HED-000363596.summary:
<< Objectives >>

CodeBLUE's general aim is to transform tourism education for the blue economy by fostering interdisciplinarity, enhancing quality and relevance, and equipping academia, students and practitioners with the skills to drive innovation and sustainability in coastal tourism and services.
The specific objectives are to 
-enhance tourism education
-create an innovative modular cross-disciplinary curriculum and resources 
-upskill, &
-strengthen links, synergies and cooperation networks for blue economy

<< Implementation >>

Project activities include
- Project management for planning, implementation, quality assurance, and follow-up
- Identifying needs, gaps, and pathways for a cross-disciplinary modular curriculum in tourism adapted for micro-credentialing
- Elaborating innovative curriculum and learning resources
- Piloting and validation in real terms
- Dissemination events and strategies for HEI-business-policy collaboration to drive innovation in blue-economy tourism and services to sustain CodeBLUE impact.

<< Results >>

The project delivers:
- Map of required skills in coastal and maritime tourism, identifying gaps and paths for integrating the blue economy into tourism education
- Modular, cross-disciplinary curriculum on the blue economy for tourism and services, suited for hybrid and digital learning
- On-line training modules and inventory of open learning resources
- Strategies portfolio for university-business-policy collaboration
- Enhanced knowledge, skills and competences for blue-economy tourism.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2025-1-DE01-KA220-HED-000355925.title: Interoperability DEAL for TRAining engineers for green, sustaINable and safe transport using education in railway laboratories
2025-1-DE01-KA220-HED-000355925.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to educate future railway engineers to enhance their decision-making skills in the design, operation, and performance of infrastructure and rolling stock. This will contribute to preparing students for careers in the railway industry, focusing on modern challenges and sustainable practices, while equipping professionals with the skills and competencies to improve the safety, sustainability, and efficiency of an interoperable railway system.

<< Implementation >>

Specialised courses, utilising the facilities of dedicated railway laboratories. The proposed approach will provide appropriate tools and valuable insights necessary to address the multifaceted aspects of railway systems, aiming to achieve a more reliable, safer, and more comfortable railway network.The activities aim to teach approaches within various types of labs from the perspective of Bloom’s taxonomy in technical education, as well as common teaching methods, incl. E-Learning platforms.

<< Results >>

European Railway Laboratories Intensive Study Course (ERLISC) - a joint teaching module for students and professionals in the railway sector for training utilising railway labs is tailored to the specific conditions of national railway operation rules and specialised lab settings. ERLISC should prepare experts for creating an interoperable railway system capable of managing complex automated processes in railway transport and developing a climate-neutral, efficient, and safe EU railway system.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2025-1-DE01-KA220-HED-000358034.title: European Classroom for Mathematics Teachers Training
2025-1-DE01-KA220-HED-000358034.summary:
<< Objectives >>

EUMathClass aims to enhance future mathematics teachers' diagnostic competencies to better identify and address students' learning difficulties. By developing five modular, implemented training materials and implementing an international COIL seminar with over 90 student participants, the project seeks to improve teacher education, promote inclusive learning and foster long-term institutional cooperation across Europe, ensuring the sustainability of its outcomes beyond the project’s duration.

<< Implementation >>

The project will develop five training modules, pilot and fully implement an international COIL seminar with over 90 student participants and organize the European Contest for Math Learning Support (ECMLS) to showcase best student projects. Dissemination activities include six multiplier events (150 participants) and a final conference with at least 60 participants, OER resources and targeted digital outreach to engage teacher educators, students and educational stakeholders across Europe.

<< Results >>

EUMathClass will deliver five training modules, a sustainable COIL seminar with over 90 student participants and accessible educational resources. Expected outcomes include improved diagnostic skills among future teachers, integration of modules into at least four partner curricula and widespread adoption of materials beyond the consortium. The project will foster long-term improvements in mathematics teacher education, benefiting students, educators and institutions across Europe.
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market
Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2025-1-DE01-KA220-HED-000358738.title: BELONG at HEI: Building Inclusive Communities in Higher Education
2025-1-DE01-KA220-HED-000358738.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The BELONG@HEI wants to enhance belonging for women and disadvantaged students in Higher Education Institutions (HEIs).

Our approach is to foster a culture of belonging and inclusivity within HEIs by developing and implementing an evidence-based Belonging Framework, open education resources and secure piloting and HEI policy influence.

<< Implementation >>

We will:

1) Conduct Participatory Action Research for Belonging at HEI Framework
2) Apply Capacity Building and Training in Belonging through OERs
3) Ensure custom approach through Belonging@HEI Self-assessment Toolkit
4) Build sustainability via Guidebook & Training on Embedding Educational Change, Institutional Learning, Uptake

<< Results >>

1. Project Management Handbook + strategies

2. Belonging Opportunities Analysis and Best Practices Report; Co-Created Belonging Framework

3. OERs on Inclusive Teaching and Belonging; Pedagogical Guide for HEIs; Capacity-Building Workshops; International Training in Cagliari, Italy

4. Comprehensive Self-Assessment Toolkit

5. Guidebook on Embedding Educational Change; Training Sessions; International Sustainability Workshop Emmendingen, Germany

2025-1-DK01-KA220-HED-000355650.title: Training for early-stage researchers on Evidence-Informed Policymaking
2025-1-DK01-KA220-HED-000355650.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The TESAR project aims to bridge the gap between research and policymaking by empowering early-stage researchers (ESRs) with practical skills in Evidence-Informed Policymaking (EIPM). Through innovative training, digital tools, and cross-sector collaboration, TESAR enhances ESRs’ ability to translate research into impactful policies. By fostering connections between academia, policymakers, and the public, TESAR promotes transparent, inclusive, and evidence-based decision-making across Europe.

<< Implementation >>

The TESAR project implements 5 interconnected WPs to strengthen EIPM. WP1 ensures effective project management, while WP2 develops and delivers innovative EIPM training for ESRs, including micro-credentials. WP3 creates a simulation environment for hands-on policymaking practice and policy brief co-creation. WP4 integrates AI tools to enhance research communication. WP5 focuses on sustainability, scaling up results through national events, media outreach, and scientific publications.

<< Results >>

The TESAR project will deliver impactful results, including innovative EIPM training modules with micro-credentials, enhancing ESRs policymaking skills. A digital simulation environment will offer hands-on policy practice, while an AI prompt repository will improve research communication. The project will produce policy briefs, scientific publications and awareness campaigns. Long-term outcomes include institutionalized EIPM training, stronger academia-policy links and greater public engagement.
topics: Initial and continuous training for teachers, trainers and other education staff
New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-EL01-KA220-HED-000358677.title: Berry Bright Futures: Empowering sustainable and innovative blueberry farming
2025-1-EL01-KA220-HED-000358677.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The Berry Bright Futures project is a unique initiative that looks to the future and aims to close the gap between traditional farming and the latest technological developments. Through the integration of entrepreneurial education, digital farming technologies, and environmentally friendly approaches, we are committed to developing a sustainable, market-oriented, and environmentally friendly blueberry farming sector.

<< Implementation >>

Project will implement 4 Work packages. WP 1 will be devoted for general management of the project. WP2 will be devoted for elaboration of the complex curriculum, WP3 will be devoted for elaboration of the e-learning platform and WP 4 will be assigned to elaborate comprehensive guidebook. Moreover, we will have few transnational meetings in the frame of the project as wella s pilot testing and final conferences in each of the project country.

<< Results >>

WP2: Curriculum and training materials: A comprehensive and modular curriculum that will provide participants with market skills, digital farming tools, and sustainable agricultural practices.
WP3: E-learning platform and pilot: A dynamic and interactive e-learning platform for the purpose of easily accessible, self paced and industry relevant education. 
WP4: Guidebook: A complete guidebook in the form of a permanent knowledge base for blueberry farming, digital marketing.

2025-1-FI01-KA220-HED-000357529.title: Supporting Trauma-Informed Higher Education Practices
2025-1-FI01-KA220-HED-000357529.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The STEP project aligns with the Erasmus+ priority of Building inclusive higher education systems and promoting inclusion. HEIs across Europe welcome students who have been displaced due to war and crises, many of whom experience trauma. These students face barriers to learning, such as stress and isolation. However, teachers often lack the necessary skills to support and engage with students who have experienced trauma, which can negatively impact their well-being and academic success.

<< Implementation >>

The project brings together 20 trauma experts from various disciplines related to mental health and trauma. Based on existing research and an expert survey, it develops a trauma-informed teaching framework and materials. Key activities include train-the-trainer programs and dissemination through a database, multiple webinars, and a final conference, ensuring the broad adoption of trauma-informed practices in higher education and influencing policy-level implementation.

<< Results >>

The project produces a trauma-informed curriculum, guidebook, and open-access resources to strengthen educators' skills. It fosters institutional capacity by providing training that improves psychological safety and inclusion. Long-term, trauma-informed teaching will be integrated into HEIs, improving immigrant student inclusion and academic success. Sustainable impact is ensured through embedding trauma-sensitive approaches into educational policies and teacher training programs.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses
Reception and integration of refugees and migrants
Initial and continuous training for teachers, trainers and other education staff

2025-1-FI01-KA220-HED-000362170.title: Experiential Quantum Mechanic
2025-1-FI01-KA220-HED-000362170.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The ExQuMe project aims to: 
1) enhance understanding of quantum mechanics through immersive VR storytelling with historical figures like Marie Curie, and Maria Goeppert Mayer, making abstract concepts relatable
2) boost engagement by transforming intimidating topics into captivating experiences
3) provide memorable learning via personalized storytelling, fostering retention
4)  broaden accessibility to quantum studies and encourage young women to pursue STEM careers

<< Implementation >>

VR-based educational activities, including the development of VR storytelling-driven modules, including gamification elements. The project will conduct needs analysis, training workshops for HE staff, student engagement sessions, pilot testing, and dissemination events, a project website and social media actions. Multiplier events and a final conference will ensure broad impact and sustainability, promoting digital transformation and gender inclusivity in STEM education.

<< Results >>

Five interactive VR modules, an educational framework, including gender-sensitive storytelling enhanced with gamification elements content to enhance quantum mechanics learning. The project will produce training workshops, pilot testing reports, dissemination materials, and a final conference. Expected outcomes include increased student engagement in STEM, improved conceptual understanding of quantum mechanics, and broader adoption of VR-based education in higher education curricula.

2025-1-FR01-KA220-HED-000363163.title: Green Erasmus 2.0
2025-1-FR01-KA220-HED-000363163.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to drive sustainable behaviour change in mobile students by providing effective tools to bridge the attitude-behaviour gap. It seeks to enhance universities’ societal impact through challenge-based learning and community engagement. By establishing the Green Erasmus label, it will encourage institutional change for sustainable internationalisation. Lastly, it will build a network of ambassadors to amplify its impact and ensure long-term adoption of sustainable practices.

<< Implementation >>

The project features diverse activities, including qualitative and quantitative research to develop a self-assessment tool and online sustainability courses for students. A Living Lab and local projects will embed sustainability in curricula through challenge-based learning. A Community of Practice will co-create the Green Erasmus Label, while multiplier activities will empower change-makers and ensure the project's lasting impact.

<< Results >>

The project will produce a theoretical framework for behaviour change models for sustainability, along with a self-assessment tool and online courses for students. An educational framework for challenge-based learning for sustainability will enhance universities’ societal impact. A Green Erasmus label will introduce a quality standard for sustainable internationalisation of higher education. A multiplier effect will be built through a network of Green Erasmus Ambassadors.

2025-1-HR01-KA220-HED-000355135.title: Streamlining AI in Learning Reimagination
2025-1-HR01-KA220-HED-000355135.summary:
<< Objectives >>

SAILeR aims to provide a new perspective on learning design starting from an educators’ vision of a study program and courses aligned with the study program. Educators will have a conductor role, but will be supported by an AI assistant and a free-to-use learning design tool. Learning analytics will help educators to prepare meaningful learning design and be used as the basis for AI-supported learning content creation. Our aim is to engage at least 1000 educators in Europe and worldwide.

<< Implementation >>

SAILeR will follow the steps of the Design Thinking process and human-centred learning design and software development supporting that. The WPs focus on creating a vision of learning design (LD) at study program and course level; using AI assistance to develop LD and create content aligned with the LD; and leveraging the benefits of LD at a study program level. Each WP starts with educators’ needs analysis, followed by development of overarching concepts, supporting tools and learning materials.

<< Results >>

Main results are new concepts and tools related to learning design (LD) supported by meaningful and ethical use of AI. They will be informed by and described in research papers and reports related to educators’ perspectives on creating visions of LD, AI assistance in LD and creation of learning content, and 6 case studies of study program development in educational contexts. Learning materials, workshops and presentations will result in a broad reach and training based on the developed concepts.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-HR01-KA220-HED-000356359.title: Green Skills for Sustainable Tourism
2025-1-HR01-KA220-HED-000356359.summary:
<< Objectives >>

-Strengthen Higher Education ecosystem’s capacity to accompany the green transition of the tourism sector in coastal areas
-Develop and promote delivery of micro-credentials in the field
-Accompany the current/future workforce in the tourism sector through the process of skilling, up-skilling and re-skilling needed to accomplish the green transition strategy
-Foster transnational and academic-private cooperation to promote sustainable tourism

<< Implementation >>

-Preparation activities to set action plans
-Needs’ assessment on Green Skills for Sustainable Tourism
-Matching needs with training areas/competences of GreenComp
-Co-creation events with tourism operators and other stakeholders to develop micro-credentials
-Developing/maintaining the Green Tour Digital Hub
-Delivery the training to 500 students/operators in the field of tourism
-Translating to boost exploitability
-Valorisation activities to set the stage for a future Green Tour Network

<< Results >>

-Study on Green Skills for Sustainable Tourism in coastal areas and HE role
-Green Skills for Sustainable Tourism Programme in line with GreenComp and tailored to tourism practitioners’ needs
-Multilanguage Digital Hub for sharing results, delivering micro-credentials and foster collaboration
-Handbook for Academic Staff & Practitioners + Policy Roadmap
OUTCOMES upskilling of students and practitioners; HE system better equipped to build green skills and deliver micro-credentials
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

2025-1-HR01-KA220-HED-000356746.title: Advancing Student Skills in Environmental Monitoring Using Earth Observation and LiDAR Data
2025-1-HR01-KA220-HED-000356746.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project will aim to develop an innovative, interdisciplinary educational toolkit that equips students with essential skills in environmental monitoring using EO and LiDAR data. It seeks to enhance HEIs’ capacity to integrate these technologies into curricula, fostering digital and green skills. By bridging the skills gap in environmental geospatial technologies, the project will prepare future professionals for careers in sustainability and climate resilience.

<< Implementation >>

Implementation will include transnational meetings, an analysis of environmental monitoring practices and EO/LiDAR market trends using expert interviews and DACUM & GAP analyses, and the development of a modular curriculum, interactive MOOC, and open-access repository.Hands-on workshops, pilot projects, and student innovation labs will provide practical training, while stakeholder webinars, national dissemination events, and a final conference will ensure knowledge transfer and long-term impact.

<< Results >>

The project will develop an interdisciplinary curriculum, online courses, and an open-access EO and LiDAR resource repository. It will enhance students' employability through practical experience and industry collaboration while equipping HEIs with digital environmental monitoring capabilities. By engaging NGOs, policymakers, and communities, the project will foster data-driven decision-making and support sustainable policies for better environmental management.

2025-1-HU01-KA220-HED-000354047.title: Higher Education Institutions for Prevention Science and Quality of Life Enhancement
2025-1-HU01-KA220-HED-000354047.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to develop, implement, and evaluate an accessible, high-quality, up to date university curriculum with innovative teaching methods to support the professionalisation of prevention professionals. Pilot testing, stakeholder engagement, and strategic dissemination will ensure the efficacy of the programme. It will contribute to evidence-based prevention, influence policies to promote prevention science over the still present, (sometimes harmful or ineffective) outdated practices.

<< Implementation >>

Definition of a competency architecture at different levels of prevention activities; developing and pilot testing an evidence-based university curriculum based on prevention science, incorporating innovative teaching techniques; collecting feedback from participants and trainers; refining the curriculum based on the feedback; disseminating project results through conferences and publications; engaging policymakers to acknowledge the need for professionalisation and quality improvements.

<< Results >>

We tackle sector challenges by developing a curriculum promoting professionalisation. We provide accessible, up-to-date knowledge for professionals and graduates, bridging academic training and practice. We enhance prevention work’s reputation by engaging policymakers to integrate this certification into national systems, addressing human resource gaps for sustainability, and strengthening universities’ role in prevention through education, research, practice, and policy collaboration.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches
Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2025-1-IS01-KA220-HED-000351705.title: Teachers' education - advocating for children's rights
2025-1-IS01-KA220-HED-000351705.summary:
<< Objectives >>

1. Exploring how children’s rights and a rights-based education approach is provided for in initial early childhood education teacher training across the three partner countries.
2. Increase the competencies of students to support a rights-based education approach.
3. Enhance the competencies of academic staff to underpin their teaching of students from a children’s rights-based perspective.
4. Develop resources to support implementation of a rights-based education approach in practice.

<< Implementation >>

1. Analyses of existing teacher training across the three partner countries focused on children's rights and democratic citizenship.
2. Developing training resources to support prospective ECEC teachers and HE teachers competencies in facilitating and providing rights-based approach in ECE settings.
3. Training sessions for students and academic staff.
4. Research activities (surveys, focus groups, literature review).
5. Dissemination activities (conferences, publication, social-media presence).

<< Results >>

1. Analyses of the current status of teacher education programmes across the three countries in relation to children's rights.
2. Raised awareness of the value and importance of taking a rights-based approach to teaching and learning.
3. Increased competencies of students and academic staff
4. Developed resources for implementation of a rights-based education approach in practice.
5. Published reports on existing and future rights-based practices.
topics: Human rights and rule of law

2025-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000354183.title: Edutainment4Care: an 'intelligent' edutainment platform for enhancing the well-being of young patients and their families during prolonged hospital stays
2025-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000354183.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project's objectives are to develop innovative pedagogical approaches and tools to facilitate STEM cognitive, language, and interpersonal protocols in long-hospitalised children; promote the widespread adoption and integration of education-focused technological solutions in healthcare environments; and investigate the intersection of educational robotics and healthcare, creating new specialisation paths in the Faculties of healthcare and education, focusing on the needs of pediatric patients

<< Implementation >>

The partnership will implement research and analysis of the needs of hospitalised children; a manual of protocols for edutainment activities, incorporating input from experts and stakeholders; training sessions and workshops for healthcare professionals, educators, and caregivers on effective protocol implementation; pilot testing and validation in hospital settings to assess the impact of proposed activities on patients; and dissemination of results and resources on a website and publications.

<< Results >>

Project outcomes include the enhancement of competencies of healthcare professionals and educators in delivering edutainment interventions to develop STEM skills in long-term hospitalised children, leading to improved patient engagement and educational outcomes. Increase awareness and adoption of innovative educational approaches in hospitals, contributing to pediatric patients' cognitive, language, and interpersonal skills development. Collaboration between professionals for holistic care.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000360274.title: MoWeHOME
2025-1-IT02-KA220-HED-000360274.summary:
<< Objectives >>

MoWeHOME enhances mobile student well-being by mapping how housing search, conditions, and architecture abroad influences students’ mental health and social integration. It will establish enforceable housing quality standards, technical guidelines to develop AI tools for scam prevention, investigating well-being and design factors. It delivers robust research providing personalised analysis and recommendations, promoting inclusion, safety, and improved living conditions for Erasmus+ students.

<< Implementation >>

The project has two phases. The first focuses on comprehensive data collection and analysis through desk research, a focus group, and study visits. The second develops a technical blueprint and guidelines, policy recommendations, advocacy, and a proposal for an improved post-mobility questionnaire. It ensures real-world impact by engaging HEIs, housing providers, and policymakers through stakeholder engagement and pilot testing.

<< Results >>

Expected outcomes include a research report on student accommodation well-being, a Blueprint for AI-based scam detection, a Well-being Quality Label for integration into Erasmus+ initiatives like the Erasmus+ App, Design Living Guidelines, and a Well-being Feedback Questionnaire for Erasmus+ assessments. The project fosters safer, more inclusive student accommodation, while providing actionable policy recommendations to improve housing standards across Europe.

2025-1-NL01-KA220-HED-000365778.title: Fostering Responsible and Resilient Internationalisation in Higher Education
2025-1-NL01-KA220-HED-000365778.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The FORTIFY project aims at enhancing resilience in HEIs, equipping HEIs staff with resources and tools to adapt to uncertainty, ensuring sustainable and responsible internationalisation. The project promotes ethical and values-based internationalisation, supporting institutions to navigate complex ethical dilemmas, fostering international collaborations aligned with human rights, democracy, and academic freedom.

<< Implementation >>

The activities in FORTIFY pursue the objectives of the project and include mapping of existing resources, the development of the framework, toolbox, and learning modules such as webinars, a self-paced online course and a staff training with case studies and simulations aligned with the framework. Activities also include piloting, the establishment of a Community of Practice, practical recommendations, dissemination events and the development of a sustainability roadmap.

<< Results >>

The project will provide HEI staff with a framework to navigate international collaboration in a complex international landscape. Next to a framework the project will develop learning modules: from webinars on topics as European Values, Democracy and Human Rights to self-paced online course and staff week on assessing partnerships in sensitive contexts, strengthening European identity and European cohesion, while enhancing skills and competences of HEI staff.
topics: Human rights and rule of law

2025-1-PL01-KA220-HED-000357941.title: AI-LITERATE: Upskilling Higher Education in the Age of Generative AI and Disinformation
2025-1-PL01-KA220-HED-000357941.summary:
<< Objectives >>

AI-LITERATE seeks to boost AI literacy in higher education, focusing on Generative AI (GenAI) and disinformation. The project will design, pilot and validate a blended learning programme, aiming to upskill HEI Professors and students on GenAI. It also intends to foster international collaboration, promoting the exchange of GenAI educational best practices and guidelines across Europe, enhancing the digital competence of the academic community.

<< Implementation >>

Under the coordination of the Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań, partners will collaborate to ensure robust project management and reporting (WP1). Following a comprehensive needs analysis (WP2), an innovative blended learning programme will be implemented (WP3), piloted partly online and partly in a 3-day in-person Bootcamp (WP4). Assessment activities will evaluate project outcomes, and partners will promote results through multimedia projects and networking events (WP5).

<< Results >>

1 Blended Learning Programme on GenAI (20h online + 3-day in-person Bootcamp)
120 HEI students trained with extracurricular activity and upskilled on GenAI 
+800 HEI students reached through curricular activities 
+5000 HEI students reached through dissemination
Network of HEI and AI literacy organisations 
4 multimedia projects on GenAI
Guidelines on GenAI in HEI
1 scientific publication and 3 presentations at Conferences
1 final event
+350 HEI stakeholders involved

2025-1-PL01-KA220-HED-000359600.title: Promoting Accountable and Transparent Human-centered AI in Higher Education
2025-1-PL01-KA220-HED-000359600.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The PATH-AI initiative is set to harness the transformative power and related benefit of Generative AI in HE, with focus on acceptable use and responsible integration. This project aims to develop a comprehensive framework including policy development, education and training and ongoing ethical review. The ultimate goal is to enhance educational quality, engagement, and alignment with future workforce needs, while also addressing the challenges and principles highlighted in literature.

<< Implementation >>

1.	Definition of Responsible and Acceptable AI Integration Framework in HE: focus on policy, collaboration, benefits and challenges.
2.	Educational units (Ed. units) development and integration in engineering curricula: based on curricular gaps, emphasizing integrity and privacy, including pilot testing.
3.	Micro-credentials (MC) development:  supporting EU policy for Lifelong Learning and Employability.
4.	Expansion: post-project collaboration, joint degrees and industry partnerships.

<< Results >>

The main outcome of the initiative will be a series of up-to-date Ed. Units integrating Gen AI into engineering education, aligned with constructivist theory of learning and blended strategies, enhancing learning outcomes and engagement. Other outcomes: (1) an open access research diary, (2) guidelines for responsible integration of AI in HE, (3) engineering profiles description including relevant and updated skills, (4) micro-credentials, (5) training activities, (6) multiplier events.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses
New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-PT01-KA220-HED-000354378.title: Fostering European Nurses’ Entrepreneurial Innovation Competences
2025-1-PT01-KA220-HED-000354378.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The FENCE project aims to foster an entrepreneurial culture within Nursing Higher Education Institutions (HEIs), enhancing the entrepreneurial innovation skills and mindset of nursing students and early-career nurses. It seeks to offer comprehensive calls to action for Nursing HEIs in this field, develop and curate various self-assessment tools and educational materials for both nursing educators and students, and conduct numerous training and outreach initiatives within the project's scope.

<< Implementation >>

A systematic review of policies/frameworks to foster entrepreneurial innovation in Nursing HEIs and explore stakeholders' perceptions of current challenges/opportunities through focus groups. A task force of international experts will co-design evidence-based recommendations, a self-assessment and learning platform for students, as well as training courses for academics, students, and early-career nurses. These resources’ feasibility and meaningfulness will be tested by the 8 European partners.

<< Results >>

FENCE’s expected co-design outcomes are: i) international consensus recommendations on fostering entrepreneurial innovation in Nursing HEIs; ii) a self-assessment and learning platform for students and early-career nurses; iii) digital educational libraries for self-paced learning; iv) virtual active learning and train-the-trainer courses for stakeholders; iv) multiplier and outreach events, culminating in the launch of the European Nursing Entrepreneurship and Innovation Observatory.
topics: Support for European and regional innovation and smart specialisation strategies

2025-1-RO01-KA220-HED-000363844.title: PRActical and Communication based MARitime ENGlish Plus
2025-1-RO01-KA220-HED-000363844.summary:
<< Objectives >>

PraC-MARENG Plus aims to enhance English communication skills of students and port and shore personnel by developing an online platform based on Standard Maritime Communication Phrases (SMCP). It will address the communication gap in port operations, improving safety and efficiency. By integrating SMCP into port operations, the project will contribute to improving language skills and increasing digitalization in maritime higher education and in the maritime industry.

<< Implementation >>

The project will develop an online training platform tailored for students and port and shore personnel, focusing on job-specific communication in Maritime English. Activities include development of a curriculum and an online course with real-life case studies and interactive simulations. Pilot testing, feedback collection and continuous improvements will ensure effectiveness before the final platform launch and dissemination. Collaboration with industry stakeholders will be conducted.

<< Results >>

The outcomes include improved Maritime English skills of students and port/shore personnel, leading to safer and more efficient operations. The project will enhance international cooperation and increase the quality and relevance of the partners’ work. The digital platform will serve as a sustainable learning tool, increasing digital skills and professional development. Long-term benefits, albeit not direct results, include increased attractiveness of the programs and occupational satisfaction.
topics: Teaching and learning of foreign languages

2025-1-RO01-KA220-HED-000364478.title: Strengthening green and digital capacities in higher education through collaboration in integrating historical buildings into a sustainable and digital future
2025-1-RO01-KA220-HED-000364478.summary:
<< Objectives >>

•Creation of comprehensive and open transnational knowledge base
•Integration of modern digital tools in HE
•Improved collaborative research
•Strengthening the capacity building in HE
•Fostering interdisciplinary learning
•Enabling effective knowledge diffusion
•Integration of green practices in HE capacities
These enhance HEIs by fostering digital and green capacities, improving data-driven research and ensuring the tools and knowledge necessary for the sustainable conservation and restoration.

<< Implementation >>

Project activities refer to data integration, research results, modernizing curriculum, incorporating digital tools and green practices, promoting international cooperation and ensuring that students gain a comprehensive, interdisciplinary education, in order to improve the quality of teaching, research, practice and sharing knowledge. At the end, all HEIs will together develop a methodology that integrates energy, seismic, and microclimatic aspects in the restoration of historical buildings.

<< Results >>

•Digital tools•Trained 8 professors and 180 students•Open online database (5250 characteristics)•Numerical models for simulating behaviour•Measures for seismic and energy restoration•Predictive analytics models for maintenance needs, energy optimization and detection of structural issues•Methodology that integrates energy, seismic, and microclimatic aspects in the restoration•1 new master's programme(15 students)•16 amended courses•1 hybrid transnational course (50 students) •11 articles•368 EDC

2025-1-RS01-KA220-HED-000366158.title: Urban Heat Island Research and Evaluation System
2025-1-RS01-KA220-HED-000366158.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The U-HIRES project strengthens HEI capacities through international collaboration, integrating UAV-based environmental monitoring, AI-driven climate analysis, and GIS-based urban planning. Partnering universities—Belgrade, Maribor, and Rijeka—enhance research, modernize education, and support student mobility. The project develops an advanced UHI monitoring system, improves climate resilience, fosters academia-industry cooperation, and promotes sustainable urban planning across Europe.

<< Implementation >>

The U-HIRES integrates UAV-based monitoring, AI-driven climate analysis, and GIS tools to assess urban heat islands. It develops real-time data collection, predictive models, and an interactive mapping platform for urban planners. The U-HIRES modernizes education by introducing interdisciplinary curricula, AI tools, and digital learning. Strengthening university-industry collaboration, training programs, and mobility initiatives, U-HIRES enhances climate resilience and policy-driven solutions.

<< Results >>

The U-HIRES enhances climate resilience, modernizes HE, and fosters regional cooperation. It develops a UAV-based monitoring system with AI-driven analysis and a GIS platform for real-time climate data. The U-HIRES modernizes curricula with interdisciplinary courses, AI-assisted and project oriented learning. Training programs and mobility initiatives strengthen competencies. By integrating research into policy and fostering collaboration, U-HIRES drives innovation in climate adaptation.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-SE01-KA220-HED-000359563.title: Multimodal AI for Personalized Adaptive Student pathwayS
2025-1-SE01-KA220-HED-000359563.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The MultAI-PASS initiative aims to leverage multimodal AI to support personalized learning pathways by adapting educational content to different learning styles. This project will develop a framework that enables educators to utilize AI tools to transform course materials, ensuring inclusivity and adaptability. Additionally, it will create an individual student passport for personalized access to courses, enhancing engagement, effectiveness, and alignment with diverse learning preferences.

<< Implementation >>

1.	Review and identification of AI tools supporting multimodal learning, including content transformation across different formats.
2.	Development of a universal student passport to enable personalized learning experiences across compliant institutions.
3.	Proof of concept through the development of microcredentials with AI-adapted learning materials and personalized pathways.
4.	Implementation and testing with students and teachers to refine AI-generated materials and integrate human oversight.

<< Results >>

The project will deliver a method for teachers to leverage multimodal AI tools, a universal student passport for adaptive learning, and proof-of-concept microcredentials with personalized pathways. Additional outcomes include (1) research on human-AI collaboration in education, (2) classification of AI-generated content (3) guidelines for integrating AI into personalized learning, (4) student and teacher feedback on AI-supported adaptation, (5) training activities, (6) multiplier events.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2025-1-SI01-KA220-HED-000361291.title: The WELL-being University: Nursing Higher EDucation Back to Health
2025-1-SI01-KA220-HED-000361291.summary:
<< Objectives >>

1. To strengthen the well-being, including digital well-being, and green competences of higher healthcare education educators through training and expertise exchange.
2. To boost the capacities of healthcare higher education institutions by pooling educators' knowledge and creating original educational content.
3. To advance the physical and mental well-being of healthcare educators, students and practitioners through activities and training.

<< Implementation >>

The following activities will be implemented:
WP1: Project Management,
WP2: Exchanges of expertise and in-house trainings for healthcare educators,
WP3: Development and piloting of educational outputs: a Guide for Educators, an elective Well-Being and Self-Care course with a digital component, and a habit tracking app,
WP4: Multiplier events.

<< Results >>

- improved well-being, digital & green competences of 100 higher healthcare education educators, 100 higher healthcare education students, 50 healthcare professionals and 20 secondary vocational school teachers, 
- developed digital Guide for Educators for work with healthcare students & professionals in the area of well-being, 
- developed Well-Being & Self-Care undergraduate course & digital component,
- built habit tracking app,
- drafted Guidelines for Organizing Eco-Friendly Campus Events.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-SI01-KA220-HED-000366095.title: TEACHING GREEN AND DIGITAL SOLUTIONS TO THE FUTURE GENERATIONS OF ENGINEERING STUDENTS
2025-1-SI01-KA220-HED-000366095.summary:
<< Objectives >>

This project addresses gaps in green and digital skills training, equipping both education staff and engineering students with the competencies needed for the green and digital transition. Focusing on sustainability and digitalization, it aligns with the European Education Area’s goals and Digital Education Action Plan, contributing to the green transition. It encourages innovation, collaboration, employability, and supports the development of leaders in green technologies and digital solutions.

<< Implementation >>

The project will design new master’s courses and develop innovative learning materials on green and digital solutions. These will cover topics such as sector coupling, chemical energy storage, green technologies, and digital tools (Digital Twin, Distributed Control Systems,...). Training for PhD students and staff, along with hands-on trainings, workshops, summer schools, industry visits, and digital platforms integration will be conducted to ensure knowledge transfer and practical learning.

<< Results >>

The project will develop green and digital course materials, integrate advanced engineering tools and knowledge of circular economy, and enhance learning through VR-based training. It will organize workshops, summer schools and industry visits to complement on-site process training. Results will be widely disseminated through a website and digital channels. Long-term outcomes include improved engineering education, greater collaboration between industry and academia and improved employability.

2026-1-AT01-KA220-HED-000462544.title: DigiCampus Connect: Empowering Student Belonging Across Digital and On-Campus Spaces
2026-1-AT01-KA220-HED-000462544.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Drive a lasting shift in higher education from ad-hoc wellbeing actions to an institutional model of belonging that is measurable, inclusive, and replicable. DigiCampus Connect equips HEIs with a shared evidence base, practical resources and training, and an integrated digital platform so belonging becomes part of teaching, student services and campus governance - not a one-off project activity.

<< Implementation >>

We will run a closed-loop delivery cycle: co-create and curate a Compendium of proven campus belonging practices; develop and pilot an educator Toolkit with short learning modules and facilitation formats; launch a Dual-Realm Platform that hosts resources, peer-led circles and feedback tools; validate through campus pilots and cross-border meetups; and finalise a replication package plus policy recommendations to support uptake by non-partner HEIs.

<< Results >>

The project will deliver a practical ecosystem for institutionalising belonging: a Compendium of transferable practices, an educator Toolkit with learning components and facilitation formats, and a Dual-Realm Platform supporting engagement, feedback and implementation. Outcomes include stronger staff capacity, tighter cooperation between teaching and student services, and a replicable model for adoption beyond the partnership through a replication package and policy recommendations.

2026-1-BE01-KA220-HED-000463312.title: Advancing Reasoning in Clinical education with AI: Collaborative, Accountable, Responsible and Ethical
2026-1-BE01-KA220-HED-000463312.summary:

This project will strengthen the initial training of future healthcare professionals by building AI literacy and responsible AI use among students and educators, while improving clinical reasoning through structured practice. 
The project will train students and educators to use AI critically and responsibly in their professional practice and health education. It will also deploy an AI “simulated patient” chatbot to enable repeated clinical thinking practice supported by structured feedback gene

The project will be implemented through a series of coordinated activities at the European level:
•	An analysis of current practices and educational needs regarding the use of AI in clinical reasoning education.

•	The development of an open digital

The project is expected to deliver concrete, transferable and sustainable results, including:
•	a European pedagogical framework to guide the responsible use of AI in clinical reasoning education.
•	an open-access digital toolbox containing an AI-based “simulated patient” chatbot, a structured library of clinical scenarios and prompts to support repeated practice across multiple cases. Clinical scenarios are structured chatbot prompts that include the key information and guidance needed to pract
