2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000353056.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000353056.title: Green Revolution Environmental Education Nurturing
2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000353056.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project goal is the creation of teaching materials and digital resources with examples and models of energy efficiency.
We divide our goal into two specific objectives:
• Creation of teaching and digital materials on efficient use of energy and water for teaching/training purposes;
• Creating models of a self-sustaining vertical garden from recycled materials.
The achievement would be raising awareness that we can implement with minor or no technological investments.

<< Implementation >>

GREEN is a project based on two Erasmus+ Priorities:
• Environment and fights against climate change and
• Contributes to innovation in vocational education and training.
We will connect formal knowledge about energy efficiency with practical implementation and concrete examples. Outcome
materials will be presented to the broader community.
They will be a helpful resource for raising awareness of environmental issues and drawing attention to that technology can
make the change.

<< Results >>

The most important results achieved encompass the following:
• teaching materials on efficient use of energy and water in the form of worksheets
• 5 video clips with examples of saving water and energy
• VR educational game/simulation - walk with energy efficiency
• 5 models of self-sustaining vertical gardens made from recycled materials
• 1 toolkit in six languages for creating a model of a self-sustaining vertical garden
• 5 workshops for teachers
• Final conference
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000356995.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000356995.title: Green Care Career: Advancing Health, Sustainability and Purpose in Agriculture
2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000356995.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Green Care Careers aims to modernize vocational agricultural education by integrating sustainability, mental well-being, and social responsibility. It will develop a new curriculum, open educational resources, and micro-credentials aligned with ECVET. A roadmap with recommendations and practical examples will support implementation across Europe. The project enhances the attractiveness of agricultural careers, aligning training with labor market needs, EU Green Deal goals, and digital learning.

<< Implementation >>

The project will begin with teacher training in design thinking, open pedagogy, and digital learning to support the co-creation of a Green Care curriculum. Partners will collaborate to develop structured learning modules and create open educational resources, ensuring accessibility and relevance. A micro-credential system will be designed to align with ECVET. A roadmap with practical recommendations will be developed, while extensive dissemination efforts will promote adoption across Europe.

<< Results >>

The project will deliver a comprehensive Green Care curriculum and open educational resources that equip vocational students with skills in sustainable agriculture and well-being-oriented business models. Trained teachers will apply innovative methods to make vocational education more engaging. The introduction of micro-credentials will enhance student mobility and employability. The roadmap will provide clear guidance for integrating Green Care into vocational training across Europe.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

hr.name: Ustanova za istraživanje i širenje znanja u području prehrane i zdravlja CEKOM 3LJ

2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000365387.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000365387.title: Inclusion Diversity and Equality in the VET System
2025-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000365387.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project's overall objective is the improvement of Diversity Equity and Inclusion principles in the educational and training environment, in line with the vision set out by the European Education Area. The project aims to contribute to strengthen the VET sector's capacity to meet the unique needs of disadvantaged learners significantly expanding their international mobility opportunities, increase their well-being and unlock their full potential while leveraging innovative AI tools.

<< Implementation >>

The project activities include: identifying and outlining good practices and digital tools, including AI, to support disadvantaged learners' mobilities; developing an e-learning course for VET Teacher/Trainers/Tutors with measurable results; creating Guidelines and a Set of Recommendations for VET organizations to develop policies that facilitate mobility programs for disadvantaged learners; validating and integrating project outputs into VET organizations, implementing a strategic C&D plan.

<< Results >>

A kit of educational resources and practical tools for VET TTTs to improve their competence in dealing with disadvantaged learners, particularly as regards the participation of this target audience in mobilities; a set of Guidelines and a Set of Recommendations to innovate organisation policies to face the problem; piloting of mobilities; a comprehensive CDS to support the project communication and dissemination activities including a project platform at disposal of the VET community.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

hr.name: OBRTNICKO UCILISTE - USTANOVA ZA OBRAZOVANJE ODRASLIH

2025-1-HU01-KA220-VET-000350500.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-HU01-KA220-VET-000350500.title: Front-line leaders of the future
2025-1-HU01-KA220-VET-000350500.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to equip front-line managers in the VET sector with essential leadership skills to improve organisational efficiency and employee satisfaction. It focuses on developing competencies in communication, team management, and strategic thinking through scenario-based learning and NLP techniques. By integrating a flexible, self-paced e-learning platform, the project ensures continuous professional development, fostering inclusive and effective leadership in diverse VET environments.

<< Implementation >>

The project will begin with a needs analysis to identify leadership challenges in VET institutions, ensuring the training is tailored to real-world needs. A structured leadership training programme will be developed, incorporating scenario-based learning and NLP techniques. A digital e-learning platform will provide self-paced modules, self-help tools, and certification. The training will be tested through LTTA and pilot sessions in VET institutions and refined based on the received feedback.

<< Results >>

The project will improve organisational efficiency and employee satisfaction in VET industries. It will foster inclusive leadership, enabling managers to support diverse teams and create a more collaborative workplace. By strengthening leadership, it will reduce staff turnover, enhance team cohesion, and improve well-being, fostering a motivated workforce. The digital e-learning platform will ensure lasting access to leadership training for continuous professional development.
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market
Initial and continuous training for teachers, trainers and other education staff

2025-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000352206.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000352206.title: DIgital Storytelling as a Choice of cOnscious creatiVity and undERstanding of YOUR joyful SELF.
2025-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000352206.summary:
<< Objectives >>

DISCOVER YOURSELF, through a design sprint approach and in a European dimension, aims at learners of all ages and learning mediators (in formal, non-formal and informal contexts) for
•Promoting their self-awareness and self-efficacy
•Bringing out and encouraging the sharing of positive emotions in learners and people with fewer opportunities
•Creating innovative and inclusive learning environments (virtual & physical)
•Developing digital skills through emotional digital storytelling techniques.

<< Implementation >>

•Action research focusing on how to share positive social emotions
•Preparation of a guide to promote positive emotions through storytelling
•Joint staff trainings on emotional storytelling
•Website and e-learning platform set-up
•Design and delivery of 4 training e-courses to develop digital storytelling
•Storytelling labs activation in various learning contexts
•Drafting of a sustainability report on lessons learned
•Product valorisation, transforming individual into collective stories.

2025-1-NO01-KA220-VET-000359108.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-NO01-KA220-VET-000359108.title: innoVET - Navigating Future skills through School-Work Alliances
2025-1-NO01-KA220-VET-000359108.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Our aim is to impact the development  of the VET education Norway, Romania, Italy, and Croatia. Our main objective is to enhance the quality and relevance of VET systems, through the adaptation and implementation of the innovative Norwegian Vocational Specialization (VS) Model, thus contributing directly to the innovation and labor market alignment of VET. The VS Model is explained in att document. The project will also contribute to further dissemination in N through the SLunion representatives

<< Implementation >>

The project is build on 5 WP including Project Management; (WP2) focuses on adapting the Norway Vocational Specialization (VS) Model to national contexts, aiming to enhance the responsiveness and quality of VET systems across partner countries; WP3 Peer-Led Validation of the VET Models Manual Across Europe; WP4 focuses on the seamless integration of digital tools within the VET curriculum & WP5 is dedicated to the dissemination and communication of the project's outcomes.

<< Results >>

A manual as described in WP2 and 3. Digital tools, as described in WP4 Enhanced employability of VET graduates through a refined internship model that is both industry-informed and pedagogically sound. An additional benefit will be increased awareness among teachers and school leaders. Experience from the process so far shows that knowledge spreads organically through conversations and informal exchanges, fostering growing interest in the VS model. In Norway, this has led to increased inquiries.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches
Cooperation between educational institutions and business

2025-1-PL01-KA220-VET-000360782.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-PL01-KA220-VET-000360782.title: Transforming Vocational Education Through AI and Future Classroom Labs
2025-1-PL01-KA220-VET-000360782.summary:
<< Objectives >>

AI4VET aims to empower VET educators and learners by integrating AI-driven methods into VET, enhancing personalized learning, engagement, and accessibility. It seeks to develop AI-powered tools, training frameworks, and Future Classroom Labs to support educators in adopting innovative teaching strategies. By VET actors with AI competencies and sharing results widely, the project ensures sustainable impact, fostering digital transformation and strengthening the adaptability of VET institutions.

<< Implementation >>

- Develop the AI-Powered Educational Toolkit, equipping VET educators with AI-driven teaching resources and best practices.
- Create AI-Powered Future Classroom Labs to support personalized and adaptive learning.
- Conduct Transnational Training and Local Pilots, engaging educators and learners in AI-integrated teaching.
- Launch an Online Repository for sharing AI tools and educational content.
- Implement upscaling activities, including multiplier events & a transnational conference.

<< Results >>

AI4VET enhances AI adoption in VET by equipping educators with AI-powered tools and methods, improving teaching effectiveness and student inclusivity. It will train educators and pilot AI-driven teaching strategies. As a result, the project will drive innovation in VET, ensuring AI integration becomes a sustainable practice across institutions. Over 50 educators and 300 VET learners will gain access to Future Classroom Labs, fostering adaptive and personalized learning experiences.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-PL01-KA220-VET-000362775.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-PL01-KA220-VET-000362775.title: European Tree Assessment Certification
2025-1-PL01-KA220-VET-000362775.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to develop a pan-European certification framework for Tree Assessors that enhances professional standards and facilitates cross-border recognition of qualifications. By fostering harmonized tree assessment practices, ETAC contributes to urban resilience, biodiversity conservation, and climate adaptation addressing EU priorities. The project will also integrate digital learning tools, ensuring accessibility and inclusivity for a wide range of professionals.

<< Implementation >>

A diverse consortium of 9 VET providers, arboricultural experts, and industry representatives from multiple EU countries will implement the project. Activities will include a comprehensive needs analysis, stakeholder engagement, and the co-creation of certification standards. The project will develop a structured assessment methodology, online training resources, and an examination system. A pilot certification will be conducted to test and refine the system before its implementation.

<< Results >>

The project’s outcomes include internationally recognized certification (consisting of certification standard and exam model), improved professional credibility, and a structured career pathway for tree assessors. The long-term impact will include higher employability, enhanced workforce mobility, and improved tree management practices across Europe. Additionally, ETAC will support policy alignment with EU sustainability goals, influencing procurement policies and industry standards.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

hr.name: Urbani šumari društvo s ograničenom odgovornošću za usluge

2025-1-TR01-KA220-VET-000362413.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2025-1-TR01-KA220-VET-000362413.title: Experiential & Creative Learning for Contextual & Transdisciplinary Curriculums
2025-1-TR01-KA220-VET-000362413.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Concrete objectives for the ECLECTIC-AI;

1. Enhance VET teachers' Competencies by providing training on the ECLECTIC-AI curriculum to integrate experiential learning, fostering interactive, student-centered teaching methods
2. Develop VET Students’ Skills by integrating experiential and game-based learning into the curriculum to enhance vocational, social-emotional, and conceptual abilities
3. Facilitate Cross-Sectoral Collaboration
4. Ensure Sustainable Innovation in VET

<< Implementation >>

By ECLECTIC AI;

1. Develop a holistic VET curriculum integrating vocational, social-emotional, and conceptual learning.
2. Innovate digital and localized learning environments for future-ready VET.
3. Organize a final conference for dissemination and sustainability of ECLECTIC-AI.
4. Conduct a virtual activity and international conference for global engagement.
5. Hold a Kick-off Meeting and 5 Transnational Project Meetings and an LTTA for cross-border collaboration and best practice sharing.

<< Results >>

By ECLECTIC AI;

1. VET teachers will gain expertise in integrating experiential and game-based learning.
2. A comprehensive curriculum combining vocational, social-emotional, and conceptual learning will be created.
3. Digital tools and localized content will be developed for future-ready VET education.
4. Conferences and virtual activities will promote the ECLECTIC-AI Curriculum and best practices.
5. A long-term network of VET institutions will ensure ongoing collaboration and innovation.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2026-1-AT01-KA220-VET-000450582.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-AT01-KA220-VET-000450582.title: Care2Learn: Investing in Long-term Care Education in Europe
2026-1-AT01-KA220-VET-000450582.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Care2Learn aims to modernise continuing vocational education and training (cVET) in the long-term care sector by developing a modular, competence-based training programme aligned with European frameworks. The project seeks to strengthen technical, digital and transversal skills among care staff, build the capacity of VET professionals, and create flexible upskilling pathways that respond to workforce shortages and evolving care needs across Europe.

<< Implementation >>

The project will develop a Care2Learn Curriculum Framework and a 12-unit online training programme (48 hours) supported by micro-credentials. The course will be piloted with cVET learners in six countries. A transnational Train-the-Trainer programme will prepare VET professionals and in-company trainers for delivery. National Skills Fora will support validation, while dissemination and sustainability actions will promote wider uptake.

<< Results >>

Care2Learn will deliver a transferable, EQF-aligned curriculum framework, a modular online training programme, a micro-credential system and a trained network of VET professionals. The project will directly benefit cVET learners and strengthen institutional capacity within partner organisations. The results will support improved workforce readiness, enhanced training quality and sustainable adoption of flexible learning pathways in the long-term care sector.
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

2026-1-AT01-KA220-VET-000450588.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-AT01-KA220-VET-000450588.title: FREE-lance readiness as a second-CHANCE pathway for marginalised learners
2026-1-AT01-KA220-VET-000450588.summary:
<< Objectives >>

FREE CHANCE aims to support marginalised learners who have experienced interrupted education or unstable employment to re-enter the market through freelancing. It will include freelance readiness modular training and mentoring with freelancers. The project will focus on building confidence, practical digital skills and realistic pathways into self-employment, and will also strengthen the ability of VET professionals to guide second chance learners towards flexible and inclusive career options.

<< Implementation >>

FREE CHANCE will deliver an online learning pathway to help marginalised learners to explore freelancing step by step through guided activities and practical exercises. Because AI-supported applications can lower entry barriers to freelancing, participants will test accessible digital and AI based tools in real use situations. VET professionals will take part in targeted training and learners will be supported through structured mentoring relationships with experienced freelancers.

<< Results >>

~A digital learning environment hosting a series of modular readiness units tailored to the needs of second-chance learners exploring freelance work.
-A mentoring programme to connect marginalised learners with existing freelancers in the gig economy.
~A practical digital toolkit will be developed to demonstrate how AI-supported applications can lower entry barriers to freelancing, particularly for learners with limited resources or confidence.
~Capacity-building resources for VET professionals.
topics: Equal access and transition to labour market
Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

2026-1-BE02-KA220-VET-000456297.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-BE02-KA220-VET-000456297.title: Trauma-Informed Practice for Carer Awareness, Resilience and Empathy
2026-1-BE02-KA220-VET-000456297.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The TIP-CARE project aims to strengthen the self-awareness, resilience and mental well-being of professionals and caregivers who work with traumatised and vulnerable people. The project seeks to prevent secondary traumatic stress and burnout by providing accessible tools for self-reflection, learning and peer support. In doing so, TIP-CARE contributes to sustainable, inclusive and resilient education, youth and public service systems across Europe.

<< Implementation >>

The project will develop a didactic framework, an online training course and a reflective practice manual, followed by the creation of a digital platform, mobile app and AI-based chatbot. These outputs will be validated through piloting with target groups in partner countries. Dissemination, networking and sustainability activities will ensure visibility, stakeholder engagement and long-term use of results at European, national and organisational levels.

<< Results >>

The project will deliver validated didactic and digital tools supporting self-awareness, secondary trauma prevention and reflective practice. Expected outcomes include increased awareness of secondary traumatic stress, improved coping and reflection skills among professionals, and stronger organisational practices for staff support. In the long term, TIP-CARE contributes to reduced burnout risks and more resilient and inclusive education and support systems.

2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000454105.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000454105.title: Guide Me Silver
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000454105.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Guide Me Silver (GMS) was developed as a follow-up to the Guide Me Green project. It aims to strengthen the competences of tourism professionals and VET educators to design inclusive, accessible and sustainable offers for silver travellers (60+). It responds to demographic change and exclusion risks by promoting affordable solutions, active ageing and stakeholder cooperation, while fostering a lasting European Community of Practice on inclusive tourism.

<< Implementation >>

GMS will develop a competence framework and modular CVET training (MOOC & blended workshops) to equip tourism professionals and VET educators with practical tools for inclusive and sustainable product design. Through structured co-creation activities, participants will design and refine concrete, low-budget and accessible silver travel packages addressing real destination needs. National Communities of Practice will validate and adapt results to ensure relevance and transferability across the EU

<< Results >>

Competence Framework and modular CVET training programme for inclusive silver tourism
6 MOOC modules for blended & self-paced learning
Project-based learning methodology supporting practical application 
Co-created & tested low-budget, accessible silver travel package concepts
National Communities of Practice (min. 30 stakeholders/country) evolving into a sustainable EU network
Improved professional competences, stronger VET–SME cooperation, more inclusive & sustainable tourism ecosystems
topics: Cooperation between educational institutions and business

hr.name: Agencija za ruralni razvoj Zadarske zupanije

2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000457659.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000457659.title: ASC SkillsPath – Digital Skill Profiles and Individual Learning Pathways for Inclusive Employment
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000457659.summary:
<< Objectives >>

ASC SkillsPath aims to improve the transition of autistic learners from VET into employment by shifting from deficit-based assessments to strength-oriented, evidence-based competence recognition. The project develops AI-supported baseline assessments, personalised support pathways, micro-credentials and a portable Skills Passport that make abilities visible, comparable and understandable for educators and employers.

<< Implementation >>

The project will co-design and develop an accessible digital platform, create competence frameworks, pilot AI-supported assessment and adaptive learning pathways in VET settings, and validate results through Living Labs with learners, trainers and employers. Training materials, employer toolkits and replication guides will be produced alongside dissemination and stakeholder engagement activities.

<< Results >>

ASC SkillsPath will deliver a validated platform for competence identification, personalised development pathways, micro-credentials and a Skills Passport supporting inclusive recruitment. Outcomes include improved learner confidence, better skills matching, and practical tools for VET providers and employers. The project will also provide policy recommendations and scalable resources for wider European adoption.

hr.name: Udruga za cjelozivotno strukovno obrazovanje STRUKA

2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000459166.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000459166.title: Enhancing Sustainable Agriculture and Food Production: Integrating Nanotechnological Approaches in Vocational High School
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000459166.summary:
<< Objectives >>

By implementing the project, we aim to strengthen vocational education in nanotechnology and sustainable agriculture, enhancing the knowledge and skills of teachers and students in these areas. We plan to create a curriculum equipped with modern teaching methodologies and digital tools to develop a competent workforce in the agriculture and food sectors. Additionally, we aim to reduce food waste through nanocapsulation technologies and support sustainable agricultural practices.

<< Implementation >>

The project will develop vocational training in nanotechnology and sustainable agriculture, creating educational modules and digital materials for teachers and students. Practical skills will be enhanced through lab work and nano-encapsulation, while collaborations with local agriculture and food industries will be established. Nanotechnological applications will be promoted to reduce food waste and support sustainable farming. Results will be integrated into the curriculum for long-term impact.

<< Results >>

WP1- Project Management
WP2- NanoTech Teacher Training LMS
WP3-Laboratory Studies on Food Preservation and Nutrient Enrichment with Nano-Encapsulation Applications
WP4-Nanotechnology and Sustainable Agriculture Education (Elective Course Curriculum for Students)
WP5- Dissemination

2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000460981.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000460981.title: Empowering Dance: civic skills in motion
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000460981.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Against a backdrop of rising polarisation and socio-economic fragmentation in Europe, ED3 strengthens social and emotional skills through dance. Using participatory, research-based, and practice-led methods, it develops an open-access workbook enabling dance artists/educators to apply facilitation methodologies that foster civic competencies in diverse adult learning contexts, supporting both civic engagement and dance artists/educators’ employability.

<< Implementation >>

ED3 adapts the RECTEC soft skills assessment tool and uses it with 6 adult learning dance focus groups in 6 countries. The focus group dance artists/educators works with a research team to identify approaches to movement that prioritise soft skills. These approaches are evaluated for their level of soft skill engagement and tested in 2 workshops. A digital workbook is produced, developed from the learning. 12 multiplier events share our learning in 6 European countries.

<< Results >>

ED3 will generate data on which facilitation methods best support social and emotional skills development in dance settings. Based on engagement and feedback of ~150 adults and young adults in diverse adult learning contexts in six European countries (focus groups), ED3 will create a digital workbook of facilitation methods and dance methodologies supporting soft skills and disseminate it to dance artists/educators in Europe and across-sectors.

hr.name: HRVATSKI INSTITUT ZA POKRET I PLES

2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000468229.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000468229.title: Senior Advancement in Collaborative Robotics and Education
2026-1-DE02-KA220-VET-000468229.summary:
<< Objectives >>

SACRE aims to strengthen the employability and job retention of workers aged 55+ in manufacturing by equipping them with key competences in collaborative robotics, automation and digitalisation. The project will design and validate a competence-based curriculum, aligned with labour market needs and integrated into VET systems through micro-credentials, fostering inclusive and sustainable industrial transformation.

<< Implementation >>

SACRE will analyse automation-driven changes in manufacturing and identify impacted job roles, leading to a validated competence framework (WP2). It will design and pilot a competence-based training programme for workers aged 55+, develop online modules, deploy an LMS and structure micro-credentials (WP3). The project will also implement dissemination actions, stakeholder engagement and sustainability planning (WP4).

<< Results >>

SACRE will deliver a validated competence framework targeting automation-impacted job roles, a competence-based curriculum for workers aged 55+, interactive online modules hosted on an LMS and EQF-aligned micro-credentials. Expected outcomes include improved robotics and digital competences, enhanced employability and job retention of 55+ workers, stronger SME–VET cooperation and increased capacity of institutions to support inclusive and sustainable industrial transformation.
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

2026-1-FR01-KA220-VET-000468979.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-FR01-KA220-VET-000468979.title: Safety Human Intelligence in Forestry Training – The Forestry safety paradox : more rules, same accidents. Stop adding rules ! Start shifting minds : an innovative VET response
2026-1-FR01-KA220-VET-000468979.summary:
<< Objectives >>

SHIFT (Safety Human Intelligence in Forestry Training) aims to transform how safety is addressed in forestry VET by embedding human factors and professional responsibility into training. The project enables learners to actively develop responsibility for safety, supports VET centres in integrating this approach into their practices, and engages forestry companies in shared safety practices to better align training and workplace safety cultures.

<< Implementation >>

SHIFT will organise European workshop and trainings to build a shared understanding of safety as professional responsibility. It will implement learner-centred safety experimentation in forestry VET centres, integrate the approach into institutional practices, collaborate with forestry companies through dialogue, experimentation and training, and consolidate results through research, dissemination tools and a final strategic meeting.

<< Results >>

SHIFT will deliver a shared European framework for safety as professional responsibility in forestry VET, learner-centred training and experimentation models, and organisational tools helping VET centres integrate this approach into their practices. The project will also produce training resources for companies, a reference video, a research-based article and a European roadmap supporting the long-term adoption of the approach.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches
Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

hr.name: Uciliste Studium - ustanova za obrazovanje odraslih

2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457287.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457287.title: RE-CRAFT VET - Revitalising Traditional and Artistic Craft Skills for Sustainable VET
2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457287.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to preserve and modernise traditional and artisan crafts by strengthening their role within VET-related contexts. It focuses on documenting craft skills, developing practical educational tools, fostering cooperation between craftspeople and VET stakeholders, and increasing interest of VET students and preschool children and pupils in craft professions as sustainable career pathways.

<< Implementation >>

The project will develop a common selection and skills mapping methodology and identify and document 10 traditional and artistic crafts in each of the three partner countries. Digital learning materials and a modular handbook will be produced and translated. Workshops with VET students and preschool children and pupils will pilot the modules, followed by VET-oriented recommendations and institutional cooperation agreements.

<< Results >>

The project will result in documented craft competencies, digital educational materials and a modular handbook in English and partner languages. Workshops will confirm practical usability of the materials and highlight the role of traditional crafts in sustainability, repair culture and circular economy. Recommendations will support their stronger integration within VET contexts.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches
Cooperation between educational institutions and business

hr.name: OBRTNICKO UCILISTE - USTANOVA ZA OBRAZOVANJE ODRASLIH

2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457303.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457303.title: Startup Challenge & AI Learning Model
2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457303.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to increase motivation and entrepreneurial competences of VET students through a structured challenge-based learning model. It addresses two key problems: weak cooperation between schools and industry, and the absence of a clear, transferable challenge model in vocational education. Artificial intelligence is integrated as a support tool for research, idea development and reflection, with clear boundaries and responsible use guidelines.

<< Implementation >>

The project will design a structured Startup Challenge model defining roles, cycle stages, assessment and industry involvement. A practical toolkit will support teachers and students. One aligned challenge cycle will be implemented in three countries using shared rubrics and standards, ending with a European online showcase. Risks include uneven industry engagement and misuse of AI, addressed through mentor training and clear AI guidelines.

<< Results >>

The project will deliver a validated challenge learning model and an open-access toolkit for VET schools. Three national challenge cycles will involve at least 60 students and industry partners. Expected results include increased student motivation, stronger entrepreneurial competences and improved school–industry cooperation. A sustainability plan will support continued annual implementation beyond the project period.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457530.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457530.title: Smart agriculture technology for VET
2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000457530.summary:
<< Objectives >>

General: To increase knowledge in VET on the application of smart agricultural technologies for sustainable food production by strengthening the capacities of VET staff and improving available training resources.
Specific- WP2 To implement new extracurricular activity and innovated curricula with smart agriculture
WP3 To train the trainers through model building and joint activities for implementing smart agriculture solutions
WP4 To produce teaching materials to be used in new programmes

<< Implementation >>

Project is based on three Erasmus+ priorities, Environmental, Digital and sector specific Increasing the attractiveness of VET. Activities and results of  the project keeps raising the awareness of environmental issues and draws attention to smart agricultural solutions that can mitigate envitonmental issues, enhance and promotes digitalization in agriculture and improve the competencies of VET staff and supports STEM, blended learning and virtual collaboration.

<< Results >>

Main results:
VR tour of the smart farm showcasing how smart agriculture solutions help farmers, environment and economy, subtitled 
3 smart agriculture models created and implemented to modernized curricula
instruction material for creating smart agriculture models in English and translated to national languages
Guidelines on cross-sectoral cooperation in WBL and student projects
AgroDigLab extracurricular activity program
Innovated curricula
Variety of VET resources on smart agriculture
topics: Initial and continuous training for teachers, trainers and other education staff

2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000467966.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000467966.title: Nematerijalna kulturna baština - očuvanje i prijenos znanja za održivi razvoj  (ICH prijenos znanja)
2026-1-HR01-KA220-VET-000467966.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Through this project, we aim to prevent the loss of intangible cultural heritage knowledge by systematically integrating it into vocational education. The goal is to establish a digitally supported model for transferring traditional skills, strengthen the digital and professional competences of teachers and students, introduce innovative learning methods, and increase the flexibility and attractiveness of VET programmes.

<< Implementation >>

Activities include the development of a curriculum with teacher guidelines, the creation of modular teaching materials with practical tasks and knowledge tests, the construction of an e-platform for progress tracking and certification, and the creation of a VR scenario for learning paper flower making. All elements will be tested in six phases for pedagogical validation, optimization, and ensuring long-term applicability in vocational education.

<< Results >>

The project will result in a developed curriculum with teacher guidelines, modular teaching materials in five languages, an e-platform with progress tracking and certification, and a VR scenario as a didactic tool for learning paper flower making. All elements will be tested and pedagogically validated. The expected outcome is a permanent, digitally supported, and implementation-ready model for integrating intangible cultural heritage into vocational education.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

hr.name: Međimurje University of Applied Sciences in Čakovec

2026-1-IE01-KA220-VET-000461563.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-IE01-KA220-VET-000461563.title: Community Energy Management, Education and Training Framework
2026-1-IE01-KA220-VET-000461563.summary:
<< Objectives >>

ENERGY-COMET aims to address the absence of a recognised VET pathway for REC professionals across Europe by developing a transnational evidence-based competency framework, a modular training toolkit and a portable micro-credential system aligned with EQF, ECVET and the 2022 Council Recommendation. Validated through train-the-trainer piloting in four countries and disseminated via established VET and energy networks, the project builds lasting capabilities for the clean energy transition.

<< Implementation >>

The project implements five work packages: WP1 coordinates management; WP2 develops a RECsE Competency Framework through desk research, field investigation and stakeholder surveys; WP3 produces five training modules, a digital platform, a micro-credential system via CBox Open Badges and a Trainer's Guide; WP4 validates outputs through focus groups and train-the-trainer pilots in four countries; WP5 disseminates through website, social media, multilingual materials and events.

<< Results >>

ENERGY-COMET will produce a publicly accessible European RECsE Competency Framework and five modular training units deployed on a WCAG 2.2 compliant digital platform, a Trainer's Guide enabling autonomous VET delivery, stackable Open Badge micro-credentials compliant with the 2022 Council Recommendation and documentable via Europass, and a Best Practices Report from four-country piloting reaching 80 participants, disseminated through EfVET, ICLEI and partner networks across Europe.
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

2026-1-IE01-KA220-VET-000463738.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-IE01-KA220-VET-000463738.title: Just-in-Time Digital Competence Training for Nursing and Midwifery Professionals
2026-1-IE01-KA220-VET-000463738.summary:
<< Objectives >>

JOLT equips nurses and midwives with digital competences required for modern healthcare systems. The project develops modular training, Just-in-Time learning resources and validated learning outcomes issued as European Digital Credentials, enabling flexible upskilling and sustainable integration of digital health training into IVET and CPD systems across Europe.

<< Implementation >>

JOLT begins with needs mapping involving nurses, midwives and educators to identify digital competence gaps. The project develops a modular digital training course, Just-in-Time (JIT) microlearning units and learner fiches, a self-assessment tool and validated Best Practice Case Studies. Outputs are piloted with over 400 healthcare professionals + 150 educators across 5 countries and refined through webinars, a JIT Creation Workshop and stakeholder consultations.

<< Results >>

JOLT will produce a modular digital training course (3 modules), 15 Just-in-Time microlearning videos, 20 learner fiches, a digital self-assessment tool and a Trainer’s Practical Manual. These resources will be tested with over 400 healthcare professionals + 150 educators across 5 countries. Learning outcomes will be validated through European Digital Credentials and supported by a collection of Best Practice Case Studies and policy recommendations.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2026-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000450856.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000450856.title: Training for Rural Actors enabling rural renaissance through Digital transition
2026-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000450856.summary:
<< Objectives >>

TRURALISM4.EU aims to innovate rural VET by creating an advanced curriculum for Digital Rural Managers. Equipped with inclusive tools and methodologies, they will drive digitalisation based on genuine operator and community needs, ultimately fostering a rural renaissance.

<< Implementation >>

Under the TRURALISM project a suite of operational tools (Catalogue, R3I, RDP) to support rural digitalisation will be developed. Local focus groups will co-design an innovative VET curriculum, validated via training events and an international bootcamp. A stakeholder community will be fostered, with participants signing an MoU to further disseminate the TRURALISM approach.

<< Results >>

The project’s main result is an innovative, adaptable cross-sectoral VET curriculum for rural actors, backed by a catalogue of success parameters for replicating digitalisation initiatives. It also introduces a Rural Renaissance Readiness tool and a Rural Digital Pathfinder to guide stakeholders in digital transformation, while the TRURALISM Community fosters EU-wide collaboration and best-practice exchange.
topics: Tackling geographical remoteness and involving rural areas
Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

hr.name: Agencija za ruralni razvoj Zadarske zupanije

2026-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000460755.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000460755.title: MobileGreenLab – Build It. Power It. Share It.
2026-1-IT01-KA220-VET-000460755.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The MobileGreenLab project aims to strengthen green technical skills and employability of VET learners by providing innovative, hands-on renewable energy training through mobile laboratories, modular curricula, and peer-to-peer learning. It seeks to modernise vocational education by developing and piloting a blended, peer-to-peer and hands-on training, thus improving access to practical training, and supporting Europe’s green transition through sustainable and transferable training solutions.

<< Implementation >>

The project will analyse skills needs, develop a modular renewable energy curriculum and open educational resources, design and construct 5 MobileGreenLab units, and implement peer-to-peer cascade training across partner countries. VET trainers, learners and key stakeholders will also test developed solutions for renewable energy education. It will pilot blended learning approaches, organise dissemination events, and engage stakeholders to ensure quality, impact, and long-term sustainability.

<< Results >>

The project will deliver 5 operational MobileGreenLab units, a modular EQF-aligned renewable energy curriculum with related open educational resources, technical construction manuals, and peer-to-peer training methodology. These will tighthen the gap between labour market needs and VET to support energy transition. Outcomes include improved green skills of VET learners, innovative teaching practices, stronger cooperation with industry, scalable training solutions supporting EU green transition.
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

2026-1-MK01-KA220-VET-000462826.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-MK01-KA220-VET-000462826.title: Ритам на животот – Центар за атријална фибрилација /Rhythm of Life – Center for Atrial Fibrillation
2026-1-MK01-KA220-VET-000462826.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to establish a sustainable Center for Atrial Fibrillation in Skopje, improve early detection and patient education, strengthen national capacity in electrophysiology through European mobility and mentoring, align AF care with EU standards, and ensure long-term sustainability through structured training and knowledge transfer within the Macedonian health system.

<< Implementation >>

The project will establish the AF Center in Skopje, deliver structured patient education to 600 patients, organise screening caravans in four cities, conduct 10 training workshops, implement mobility placements in Graz and Zagreb, host incoming EU experts for mentoring, and institutionalise knowledge transfer through ongoing resident training and updated clinical protocols.

<< Results >>

The project will result in a fully operational AF Center, 600 educated patients, 800 screened citizens, 11 trained doctors through mobility, 10 local workshops delivered, updated clinical protocols aligned with EU standards, strengthened national expertise in electrophysiology, and sustainable integration of patient education and screening into routine care.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2026-1-NL01-KA220-VET-000460155.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-NL01-KA220-VET-000460155.title: Circular Mind; From Learning to Leading
2026-1-NL01-KA220-VET-000460155.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Circular Minds equips VET students and teachers with green, digital and entrepreneurial competences needed in a fast changing labour market. Embeds circular economy thinking and IDGs in vocational education, linking technical skills with personal leadership and responsible entrepreneurship. An open hybrid learning hub guarantees free access and long term use of all materials. A strategy collection & transfer concept helps to ensures long-term impact and scalability beyond the project’s life.

<< Implementation >>

Circular Minds is all about knowledge and research (WP2), practical training (WP3), industry collaboration (WP4) & hybrid online knowledge sharing (WP5). Activities to be implemented are: developing six modular learning units, pilot testing with students and teachers, real-world sustainability projects, teacher training, mentorship programs and an interactive knowledge platform. Dissemination events ensure scalability, making circular entrepreneurship & sustainability education widely accessible

<< Results >>

CM delivers six hybrid learning modules, an interactive knowledge platform and real-world sustainability projects. The project enhances student's IDG skills and knowledge in circular entrepreneurship, trains educators in innovative teaching, fosters and strengthens industry collaboration. Scalable learning materials, tested in pilot programs, will be integrated into VET curricula, ensuring long-term impact and accessibility across vocational education.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2026-1-SK01-KA220-VET-000461588.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-SK01-KA220-VET-000461588.title: REVIVE+: Strengthening Vocational Education and Training for Traditional and Heritage Construction Skills
2026-1-SK01-KA220-VET-000461588.summary:
<< Objectives >>

REVIVE+ will safeguard and modernise traditional heritage construction skills by turning them into professional profiles and modular learning pathways. The project aims to improve quality, labour-market relevance and flexibility of VET for repair-first, material-compatible renovation, enabling recognition of prior learning and links between training, employers and heritage. The project preserves Europe’s shared cultural identity embedded in vernacular architecture and strengthens VET systems.

<< Implementation >>

Project will map needs and existing practices, co-design harmonised profiles and learning outcomes, and develop modular curricula, trainer guidance and performance-based assessment tools. Trainers will be calibrated, and modules will be piloted in school-based VET and field settings at vernacular heritage sites. Employers, chambers, experts, heritage bodies and VET authorities will validate results. National integration roadmaps and a Moodle learning environment will support uptake.

<< Results >>

REVIVE+ will deliver harmonised professional profiles and EQF-referenced learning outcomes aligned with NQFs and ESCO; a modular curriculum package for IVET and CVET, with trainer methodology and assessment/evidence templates; pilot-tested, refined modules validated by employers and heritage experts; national integration roadmaps and employer guidance supporting system positioning and employability and a Moodle-based digital environment for blended delivery and competence-evidence capture.
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

2026-1-TR01-KA220-VET-000449925.action_type: Cooperation partnerships in vocational education and training
2026-1-TR01-KA220-VET-000449925.title: AI-Supported Smart & Green Manufacturing Skills for VET
2026-1-TR01-KA220-VET-000449925.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to strengthen students' technical competencies and employability by developing EQF-based modules and applied learning tools that are compatible with the digital and green transformation in vocational education. A sector-aligned and European-level transferable application model will be created, enhancing institutional capacity through teacher training, simulation-based case studies, and measurable assessment tools.

<< Implementation >>

The project will include the preparation of a needs analysis and a role-based competency matrix; the development of EQF-compliant modules, a teacher training program, and digital learning materials. Learning outcomes will be measured through pilot applications, simulation-based case studies, and LMS-based e-exams. Results will be shared at local and European levels through international virtual workshops, institutional visits, multiplier events, and dissemination activities.

<< Results >>

The project will ultimately develop EQF-compliant modules, teacher guides, simulation-based case studies, and assessment tools. Learning outcomes validated through pilot applications, pre-test and post-test analyses, e-exam performance reports, and a comprehensive impact assessment report will be obtained. The transfer and long-term use of the results will be ensured through an open-access digital content repository and a standard dissemination package.
