2024-2-HR01-KA220-YOU-000278693.title: Health Literacy Education for Youth to Tackle Disinformation and Improve Well-being (Health-Lit)
2024-2-HR01-KA220-YOU-000278693.summary:
<< Objectives >>

HEALTH-LIT aims to enhance the health literacy (HL) of young people (14-29 yrs), equipping them with skills to address disinformation about health issues and to promote digital readiness and resilience. The project seeks a systemic impact on youth engagement in Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Italy, and Lithuania, by improving the skills and competences of youth workers and educators to apply innovative methodologies for HL and tackling disinformation, reinforcing the links practice and youth policy.

<< Implementation >>

Activities encompass online survey of young people in 5 countries; designing an inclusive multi-lingual health literacy and disinformation program through innovative local and international youth sandbox (VOYS); peer learning and training of trainers; developing and disseminating e-learning HL resources; engaging youth, youth workers, local stakeholders and the wider public in mutual learning and awareness-raising through multiplier events and webinars; project evaluation activities.

<< Results >>

1. Increased understanding of health disinformation challenges and HL programs for youth.
2. Designed learning and training resources for HL (training program, playbook with resources and guidance, HL awareness content)
3. Trained youth activists and built capacity for promoting HL through youth work.
4. Promoted youth civic engagement for sustaining social cohesion and resilience to disinformation amongst youth.
Over  700  persons will be engaged in activites, and estimated 5000 reached online.
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work

hr.name: UDRUGE CENTAR ZA MIR, NENASILJE I LJUDSKA PRAVA - OSIJEK

2024-2-HR01-KA220-YOU-000279458.title: Inclusive Pathways to Peace
2024-2-HR01-KA220-YOU-000279458.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project "IPP" will strengthen the capacities of the organizations involved through creating innovative OERs. It aims to  engage and empower 181 youth with conflict resolution skills through game-based educational resources and to increase the quality of youth work by equipping 130 youth practitioners with new skills, approaches and tools. The project promotes common values such as tolerance, inclusivity, and understanding, ultimately contributing to building cohesive and peaceful societies.

<< Implementation >>

The project will implement Participatory Action Research to gather insights on youth perspectives regarding violence incidence, attitudes towards marginalized groups, and solutions for positive change. This will be followed by the development of 8 interactive educational Escape Rooms with digital elements such as 360-degree video and Augmented Reality. OERs will be created in 5 languages to facilitate widespread access. P2P, ToT, e-learning and dissemination will further enhance the impact.

<< Results >>

The project foresees the development of 4 outputs. It goes beyond traditional learning to address critical socio-political issues, equipping pax with conflict prevention, critical thinking and communication skills, improved engagement of youth, development of inclusive and sustainable OERs, and broader adoption of innovative peace education methodologies. We anticipate contributing to the promotion of democratic values, social cohesion, and the prevention of radicalization in Europe and beyond.
topics: Human rights and rule of law
Quality and innovation of youth work

hr.name: UDRUGA ZA PROMICANJE AKTIVNOG SUDJELOVANJA STUDIO B

2024-2-HR01-KA220-YOU-000288789.title: Beyond Tokenism Youth Leading Inclusion
2024-2-HR01-KA220-YOU-000288789.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to combat tokenism by promoting genuine inclusion in youth organizations. We will strengthen organizational capacities, raise awareness, and develop digital tools and educational materials to support authentic inclusion. Additionally, the project seeks to establish an international network and promote lasting commitments to diversity across Europe.

<< Implementation >>

We will implement activities including developing digital tools like the Inclusion Index Calculator, creating educational materials, and conducting workshops to raise awareness about tokenism. The project also includes organizing study visits, establishing an international network of organizations, and promoting the Authentic Inclusion Declaration. We will hold pilot workshops, local community events, and a final conference to disseminate project results and foster genuine inclusion.

<< Results >>

The project will produce key results, including the Inclusion Index Calculator, an educational toolkit, and the Authentic Inclusion Declaration. We expect enhanced awareness of tokenism, improved inclusion practices in youth organizations, and the establishment of an international network. Project will result in increased competence among youth workers, widespread dissemination of tools and materials, and long-term commitments to genuine inclusion across participating organizations and beyond.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2024-2-IE01-KA220-YOU-000278079.title: Building Relationships for Inclusive Digital Growth and Engagement
2024-2-IE01-KA220-YOU-000278079.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The BRIDGE project aims to promote responsible and safe Internet use by engaging with autistic youth to learn about their views of the internet, how they interact with online platforms and content and with others online.   This co participative research along with desk research will inform consultations with families and autistic youth to agree on safe and healthy internet use.The combined outputs will inform the development of an online toolkit for all target groups.

<< Implementation >>

The BRIDGE project is going to implement: 

Co-participatory research with autistic youth and their internet use and online behaviour.
Desk research on partner country national services, strategies and literature.
Awareness-raising events and family consultation sessions on the use of the Internet by autistic youth and consensus building on safe and healthy online use. 
Knowledge transfer activities and sessions to foster the capacity of professionals working with autistic youth.

<< Results >>

Evidence-based, participatory research with autistic youth on their internet behaviours.
Desk based national reports and consolidated transnational reports on services and strategies for supporting autistic youth and their families on safe internet use.
Awareness-raising campaign and materials for families and caregivers of autistic youth. 
A toolkit for professionals, families and autistic youth on safe and healthy internet use.
Policy recommendations to inform stakeholders across the EU.
topics: Bridging intercultural, intergenerational and social divide

2024-2-IT03-KA220-YOU-000276680.title: Debate Science Hubs: Promotion of Scientific Literacy through Active Participation in Science Dissemination and Citizen Science
2024-2-IT03-KA220-YOU-000276680.summary:
<< Objectives >>

With DEXTER we aim to increase the quality and inclusiveness of STEM education through scientific literacy and debate-based youth work, train educators, and empower youth participants to debate STEM topics. We seek to foster public engagement with science, increase trust in science, and equip young people to advocate for informed decision-making. We ensure inclusivity by focusing on underrepresented groups, such as girls and disadvantaged youth, supporting their engagement in scientific issues.

<< Implementation >>

DEXTER will develop STEM curricula and a debate toolkit to integrate STEM into youth work. We will train educators to run Science Debate Hubs, combining debates and citizen science projects. Public debates will be organized to engage communities on key scientific topics. We will create STEM debate case studies for youth participants and train Science Ambassadors to lead advocacy efforts in their communities, fostering engagement with scientific issues.

<< Results >>

DEXTER will produce several key results: 1) STEM curricula and a debate toolkit for youth workers. 2) Trained educators equipped to integrate STEM and debates into youth work. 3) Science Debate Hubs established, promoting critical thinking and scientific literacy. 4) Public debates and advocacy led by Science Ambassadors. 5) STEM debate case studies developed to guide youth in exploring scientific controversies. 6) Increased youth engagement in STEM, especially among underrepresented groups.
topics: Bridging intercultural, intergenerational and social divide
New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2024-2-IT03-KA220-YOU-000294330.title: In Gianky We Trust
2024-2-IT03-KA220-YOU-000294330.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Main goal: improve AYP's 20-25 aged understanding of the value of money and their ability to make autonomous financial decisions. Specific objectives: improve their financial knowledge through the creation of accessible educational materials aligned with their way of learning (SO1), improve their practical financial skills thanks to the development of learning tools and learning opportunities  (SO2), and strengthen their social inclusion/encourage active participation through community building.

<< Implementation >>

Key activities include developing FE material for AYP, implementing the Gianky app, producing video tutorials, and creating workshop formats for diverse settings. The project includes organizing Gianky HUBs, an online community via Slack, parent-child engagement days, local pilot testing of workshop formats, training youth workers, conducting workshops for parents/legal guardians, producing a podcast and a FE board game, and an international mobility exchange for AYP in Spain.

<< Results >>

Project results are: adapted financial education material for AYP, Gianky app in ENG and partner languages, video tutorials explaining how to use the learning material, workshop format in 3 settings to practice financial edication, parent-child engagement day format, FE Boardgame, establishment of Gianky HUBs and online Slack community to help AYP practice FE and social skills, 5 VIBES-based training modules to train Gianky facilitators, a 8 episode podcast series.

hr.name: CROATIAN ASSOCIATION OF SOCIETIES OF PERSONS WITH INTELLECTUAL DISABILITIES

2024-2-MT01-KA220-YOU-000278887.title:
Building Bridges: Addressing youth stressors through
workshops for adolescents and their caregivers
2024-2-MT01-KA220-YOU-000278887.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The main aim is to help our youth to be better understood with regards to the life challenges and stressors they face.
Objective 1: Understanding better our youth, especially when it comes to challenges and stressors. 

Objective 2 is to help the care givers to better understand their children and how to support them.  

Objective 3 would be that of actually having the young people trained how to face life challenges.

Objective 4 is actually that of preparing material that youth workers can  us

<< Implementation >>

The activities are:

An in-depth study to better understand the challenges that youth are facing

The creation and delivery of workshops based on these challenges’ with young people and their care givers.

Evaluation of the material created and the publication of the guidebook that will gather all the research carried out and material produced. 

Dissemination to make sure to make what we created visible and easily reached accessed by others.

<< Results >>

The results are:

-	A better understanding  of what the youth are facing today
-	Youth will be better trained how to face these challenges and how to be more resilient
-	Care givers will understand what youth are facing and what support they can offer. 
-	A guidebook that will collect all research and material produced including the session for youth and caregivers. 
-	Great networking between the partners that can lead to new projects that benefit the community.
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work

2024-2-NO02-KA220-YOU-000285372.title: MEtaverse Futures: Education beyond Realms - MEFER
2024-2-NO02-KA220-YOU-000285372.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The MEFER project aims to empower youth workers by equipping them with the tools, knowledge, and skills needed to integrate immersive technologies into their work with young people. The project will foster digital literacy, promote ethical online engagement, enhance digital security awareness, and address psychological impacts of virtual isolation. MEFER will ensure sustainable, future-focused youth work practices by creating an interactive 3D learning platform and tailored curriculum.

<< Implementation >>

The MEFER project will implement 4 activities, including:

- Data collection and needs assessment through surveys, focus groups, and interviews with youth workers.
- Development of a comprehensive curriculum for youth workers on immersive technologies.
- Creation of a 3D Virtual Learning Platform with educational materials.
- Local and international workshops to test and disseminate the outputs.

<< Results >>

The MEFER project expects to deliver 4 results:

1.A comprehensive curriculum for youth workers on immersive technologies.
2.A 3D Virtual Learning Platform with interactive educational materials.
3.Improved digital literacy, digital security, and digital ethic awareness among youth workers.
4.A needs assessment report highlighting challenges and opportunities in integrating immersive technologies into youth work.

2024-2-PL01-KA220-YOU-000286535.title: Y-CARE - Youth-Centered Approaches for Resilience and Empowerment
2024-2-PL01-KA220-YOU-000286535.summary:
<< Objectives >>

O1: Enhance the mental well-being and resilience of youth workers through targeted training and resources.
O2: Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing among partner organizations and stakeholders to create a supportive community.
O3: Increase awareness of mental health issues and effective practices within local communities and among youth workers.
O4: Establish sustainable peer support networks that provide ongoing assistance and resources for youth workers.

<< Implementation >>

1) State of the Art Research on Mental Wellbeing: We will conduct desk and benchmarking research and create peer support networks.
2) Training and E-Learning Platform: We will develop and deliver training programs to improve youth workers' skills and resilience.
3) Awareness Campaigns: We will promote burnout risks and best practices through media and national and European events.
4)Establishment of Peer Support Networks: Set up sustainable peer support networks in 6 EU Countries.

<< Results >>

The Y-CARE project expects to enhance the mental well-being and resilience of youth workers by reducing burnout risks through targeted training and support networks. It aims to establish a functional peer support system and mentorship programs, fostering better work-life balance and stress management. The project will also deliver an interactive e-learning platform, raising awareness about mental health challenges while promoting best practices across organizations and broader communities.

2024-2-RO01-KA220-YOU-000273905.title: Roma Youth for Sustainable Future
2024-2-RO01-KA220-YOU-000273905.summary:
<< Objectives >>

RYSF empowers Roma youth by equipping them with green and digital skills, and promoting entrepreneurship to break cycles of exclusion and poverty. In alignment with EU priorities, the project will train over 100 young Roma and 30 educators through practical, hands-on activities. These include curriculum development, mentoring, and a Green Entrepreneurship Conference. By fostering sustainable business models and enhancing employability, RYSF aims to reduce unemployment and empower Roma youth.

<< Implementation >>

RYSF will implement targeted activities to equip young Roma with green and digital skills, promote entrepreneurial thinking, and foster social inclusion. Key activities: tailored educational curricula focused on green entrepreneurship and digital literacy, interactive online tools such as a green business simulator game. Participants will receive personalized mentoring, engage in hands-on workshops, and be involved in Start-up Challenges to develop sustainable business ideas.

<< Results >>

RYSF will empower young Roma with green and digital skills, foster entrepreneurial capacity, and promote social inclusion. Through training and mentoring, the project will enhance the employability of over 100 Roma youth, resulting in new sustainable business ventures and increased participation in non-formal education. The project will produce practical educational resources to ensure broad reach and impact. RYSF will also create ongoing support networks for young Roma entrepreneurs.

2024-2-RO01-KA220-YOU-000279040.title: Unplugged: Addressing compulsive behaviours and promoting healthy digital habits among youth
2024-2-RO01-KA220-YOU-000279040.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Enhance the capacity of 5 partners to address compulsive behaviours & screen addictions among youth through the creation of a training methodology of 8 NFE workshops
Help 45 youth/country develop coping strategies to manage compulsive behaviours linked to general internet addiction, online gaming & gambling
Raise awareness among at least 5000 youth regarding the risks of compulsive behaviours & screen addictions, encouraging them to seek further information/help and enhancing their resilience

<< Implementation >>

30 youth workers from the 5 partner NGOs will combine their expertise in coaching, psychoeducation, storytelling, art-therapy and evaluation strategies to develop an effective training program consisting of 8 topical workshops. An international training + mentoring will be provided for our teams of y.w. In each country, the training curriculum will be tested with 3 groups of 15 youth aiming to equip the participants with resilience and coping strategies to prevent and reduce screen addiction.

<< Results >>

Improved capability of partners to provide interventions to prevent screen addictions by integrating the methodology & involving 30 y.w. in its implementation
225 youth with improved understanding of compulsive behaviours & increased ability to apply coping strategies to manage their digital use & prevent addictions
5000 youth with increased awareness about screen addictions and their associated risks
Outputs:training program,incl. Manual, Workbook & videos;website with youth stories; board-game
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2024-2-SI02-KA220-YOU-000284432.title: Citizenship ED+: Citizenship education through a cross-sectoral cooperation
2024-2-SI02-KA220-YOU-000284432.summary:
<< Objectives >>

To empower at least 200 young people through non-formal methods of education on active citizenship
To develop methodological frameworks for 200 teachers and youth workers for more effective teaching of active citizenship
To improve cooperation between formal and non-formal education
To create a curriculum on active citizenship in the secondary school system and strengthen partnerships with non-governmental youth organizations
To carry out an advocacy campaign with decision-makers

<< Implementation >>

Development of a 30-hour curriculum for teaching active citizenship
International training for 30 participants
National training for 120 teachers, future teachers, and youth workers
Pilot implementation of the curriculum in 8 secondary schools
Execution of 24 projects in the local community
Development of guidelines for teaching active citizenship
Advocacy campaign for the integration of the curriculum into the school system
4 national conferences
Final international conference on the outcomes

<< Results >>

- Development of a 30-hour curriculum for active citizenship, incorporating various modules on key aspects of active citizenship.
- Pilot implementation of the curriculum in 8 schools across 4 partner countries, involving a total of at least 200 students.
- Creation of guidelines for teachers and YW to support the implementation.
- Execution of 24 student-led projects/actions in local communities.
- Evaluation report 
- 4 national and 1 international conference 
- Release of 72 short videos
topics: Promotion of alternative forms of participation

2025-1-BG01-KA220-YOU-000357303.title: NextGen Citizen: Innovating Civic Learning for Tomorrow
2025-1-BG01-KA220-YOU-000357303.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The "NextGen Citizen: Innovating Civic Learning for Tomorrow" project addresses the Horizontal priority of Erasmus+: Common Values, Civic Engagement, and Participation
The general objective of the project is to enhance civic education and promote active citizenship among young people through the development of innovative, digital, and non-formal learning and teaching tools, fostering cross-border collaboration, democratic values and social responsibility

<< Implementation >>

4 work packages are planned:
WP1Project management
WP2Non-formal civic education courses
2Workshops for youth workers
Elaboration of courses curriculum and methodology
Elaboration of guidelines
Pilot testing
WP3Digital Center for Civic Education:
Creation of a website/platform
Creation of 12 civic educational videos (aimed at youth)
Creation of a thematic YouTube channel and its initial content
Additional content for individual sections/functions of the platform
Impact analysis
WP4Dissemination

<< Results >>

The most important tangible results are:
-	new modern curricula, methodologies, and guidelines for non-formal civic education courses targeting young people aged 15-30 – developed and tested during the project (1 per country)
-	a Digital Center for Civic Education—a multilingual online platform offering new open-access educational resources (both for youth workers/educators and young people), interactive and video-based materials, and consultancy and networking opportunities for youth engagement
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

hr.name: UDRUGA ZA ODRŽIVI DRUŠTVENI RAZVOJ I VOLONTERIZAM (ASSOCIATION FOR SUSTAINABLE SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT AND VOLUNTEERISM)

2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000354058.title:
Empowering Youth: Navigating Democracy and Active
Citizenship in Times of AI
2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000354058.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The aim of ENACT AI is to support partner organizations and other non-formal youth education institutions in developing their capacity to integrate AI into their educational offerings. In this way, we strengthen them to expand and further develop their role as a driving force for innovative democracy education. Through materials, training courses and action plans, new learning formats are sustainably anchored in the institutions and the engagement and participation of young people is promoted.

<< Implementation >>

We combine expertise in democracy and digital education from four EU countries. We develop target group-oriented materials on AI in youth education, qualify specialists through a blended learning course and test youth events in practice. With action plans and stakeholder dialogues, we support institutions in the long-term anchoring of the offers. The overall package of toolbox, skills development and capacity building strengthens the organizations and youth engagement.

<< Results >>

ENACT AI strengthens the capacity building and networking of non-formal educational institutions, equips them with a collection of materials, and supports them with training and consulting services for the critical reflection on and competent use of AI in democracy education within their organizations.
The project also generates ideas for sustainable integration, international cooperation, and transfer. The results are illustrated in a manual and available as OER for use across the EU.

2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000356296.title: Climate Resilience Inside Out
2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000356296.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims: to enhance youth organizations’ capacity to address mental health issues caused by climate crisis (eco-anxiety); to equip youth workers with science-based tools to tackle climate-related mental distress, particularly among marginalized youth, and to foster climate resilience, mindful leadership, and planetary well-being through arts and culture; to strengthen cross-border partnerships enabling youth organizations to co-create innovative solutions for planetary well-being.

<< Implementation >>

A2.1 INCEPTION PARTNER MEETING
A2.2 TOOLKIT DESIGN "ROOTS OF CLIMATE RESILIENCE" (RCR)
A2.3 TRAINING FOR FACILITATORS OF THE "RCR" PROGRAM
A2.4 LOCAL IMPLEMENTATION OF THE "RCR" PROGRAM
A3.1 MANUAL DESIGN "LEADERSHIP FOR PLANETARY WELL-BEING"
A3.2 TRAINING COURSE "LEADERSHIP FOR PLANETARY WELL-BEING"
A3.3 LOCAL PLANETARY WELL-BEING ACTIONS
A3.4 LOGO & WEBSITE DESIGN 
A4.1 SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATION
A4.2 MULTIPLIER EVENTS 
A4.3 FINAL PARTNER MEETING

<< Results >>

Collaboration among partners will result in equipping them with a user-friendly "Roots of Climate Resilience" toolkit to address eco-anxiety, and skills to implement local programs among young people that foster climate resilience. The "Leadership for Planetary Well-being" manual and training course will empower youth workers to be mindful leaders for planetary well-being. Dissemination activities will expand impact, ensuring sustainability and inspiring action on climate-related mental health.

2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000362094.title: Greencademy to the Next Level: Long-term capacity building program for youth work organisations to facilitate youth-led ecological actions at the local level in the context of non-formal education.
2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000362094.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Empower young people & youth workers across Europe to lead the green transition via agroecology. 
Scale up green skills & youth-led agro-entrepreneurship, and build youth worker capacity to guide ecological agriculture projects. 
Address climate change, biodiversity loss, rural depopulation through youth action. 
Develop innovative approaches centered on holistic agriculture and entrepreneurial mindsets, ensuring socially inclusive and economically empowering green transition.

<< Implementation >>

Establish local alliances in 4 EU countries, map initiatives, engage YW stakeholders. 
Co-create agroecology pedagogical toolkit for youth workers: innovative methods, practical tools for training & entrepreneurship. 
Deliver 2 intensive capacity-building courses for youth workers: advanced green skills, holistic practices, entrepreneurial methods. 
Organize youth exchange for peer learning, toolkit testing, leadership strengthening. Implement youth-led mini-projects with mentorship, funding.

<< Results >>

Youth & Youth Work Orgs gain advanced green skills, launch agroecology ventures, become green transition leaders. 
Youth workers equipped to effectively guide & support youth. 
Pedagogical toolkit available for wider use. Youth-led mini-projects implemented.
Increased capacity for green skills & entrepreneurship across Europe. 
Enhanced youth & youth worker roles as active change agents. 
Broader impact via dissemination, advocacy, fostering long-term, sustainable youth-led green initiatives.
topics: Tackling geographical remoteness and involving rural areas

2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000365445.title: Creating Spaces of Democracy - Advancing Professional Open Youth Work Across Europe
2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000365445.summary:
<< Objectives >>

1. Creating a common European understanding of Open Youth Work (OYW), describing its fundamental principles but also the diversity of practice in the various countries

2. Strengthening OYW as a place of non-formal and informal democratic education

3. Increasing the visibility and recognition of OYW in society and politics through a publicity campaign

4. To establish and expand OYW, especially as an actor in democratic education, to countries with less developed OYW and EU-level

<< Implementation >>

Activities include:
 
- International events + workshops
- Investigation + evaluation of framework conditions under which OYW takes place in different countries
- International professional exchange on characteristics + principles of OYW in Europe and on the practice of non-formal/informal democratic education in OYW
- Transnational job shadowing processes
- Campaign planning + implementation
- Designing + disseminating a campaign media product
- Developing strategies for spreading OYW in Europe

<< Results >>

1. A European results paper that reflects a common understanding of professional OYW + serves as basis for political recommendations + strategic further development, in several languages
2. A manual for the practice of non- and informal democratic education in OYW, in several languages
3. The realisation of the campaign 'European Day of Open Youth Work' in 2027 + thereafter
4. A media product for the campaign
5. Expanding OYW to other countries + networking for OYW at the EU-level
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work

hr.name: Udruga za promicanje pozitivne afirmacije mladih u drustvu ""Impress"" Daruvar

2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000365700.title: Fit2Commit. European Tools to Engage Youth (Workers) for Social Inclusion
2025-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000365700.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Fit2Commit aims to unlock the potential of youth volunteering for social inclusion. Empowered young people gain tools for social engagement. The local youth work sector enhances methodologies, making exclusion visible. Pilot participants see reduced exclusion and better understand other groups. Partner organizations advance their development and strengthen European connections. Together, these efforts create a sound basis for more inclusive, empathetic, and socially aware communities.

<< Implementation >>

Fit2Commit implements activites in two directions: firstly, a participatory, youth-led process with research, workshops and trial activities sets the basis to create an interactive Grassroute Peer2Peer Guide for young adults, secondly, youth workers from the partner organisations are sharing and further developing good practises/methodologies for the promotion of youth volunteering with adolecents documented in a new manual. The results of both processes are promoted during trainings and events.

<< Results >>

Two tangible, multi-language outputs of Fit2Commit are a youth-oriented and -created "Grassroute Peer2Peer Guide for Youth Social Engagement", presenting low-threshold possibilites to engage, and a youth-worker centered "Manual for Youth Work Fighting Social Exclusion by Volunteering", sharing a well-tested set of informal and non-formal learning methodologies for the sector. Through the training and promotion, Fit2Commit additional expects to reach visibility for the need to fight exclusion.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches
Bridging intercultural, intergenerational and social divide

2025-1-ES02-KA220-YOU-000349773.title: CATALYST: Peer-Led Career Coaching to Support Disengaged Young People
2025-1-ES02-KA220-YOU-000349773.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Through addressing specific challenges such as mental health, social isolation, substance use, and the negative impact of social media through a peer-mentoring approach, Catalyst partners aim to create a supportive environment that helps young people to overcome barriers their employment. Our objectives are to:
*Train 8 young peer coaches each in 6 countries
*Raise awareness about mental health and reduce stigma among young people in life transition
*Engage 240 young people in peer coaching

<< Implementation >>

Through WP2, we will develop 6-module peer-coaching programme, and we will deliver this to 8 young people (aged 25-30) in each country and support them to engage 5 younger peers (18-25) each in coaching activities, so help them to overcome their personal barriers to their transition to the labour market. In WP3, we will develop a toolkit of mental health resources for young people (18-25), and we will also include online module for youth workers to train them as mental health first responders.

<< Results >>

In terms of project results, Catalyst will develop:
*6 modules as part of the Peer Coaching Training Programme for young people aged 25 to 30.
*Toolkit with mental health self-care resources for young people aged 18 to 25.
*Online modules and resources in Mental Health First Aid for Youth Workers. 

In terms of outcomes, Catalyst aims to raise community awareness and engage stakeholders, to create supportive environment for young people facing mental health issues in their transition to work.

2025-1-FI01-KA220-YOU-000358260.title: RADIX - Radical Approaches to Dialogue In youth work Praxis
2025-1-FI01-KA220-YOU-000358260.summary:
<< Objectives >>

We aim to equip youth workers with the competence needed to engage with youth on controversial views and those in core of ideological social conflicts, and to foster inclusive dialogue and cohesion. The project will develop new approaches and test pedagogical framework to youth work that strengthens the capacity of youth work promoting democratic values, produces evidence-based policy recommendations to integrate the learnings and outcomes into national and international youth work framework.

<< Implementation >>

Through joint exploration, practical experimentation, and in-depth training, the project will drive the transformation of youth work to better address current societal challenges. We will organise 1 international and 3-6 national training for at least 60  youth workers including metoring and supporing them  in  their process of implementing the newly acquired  competences. We will organise  international and national conferences. We will co-write a practical guide, method bank and white paper.

<< Results >>

The project will produce a tested and refined curriculum, equipping youth workers with dialogue facilitation and innovative youth work competences. It will enable local implementation of initiatives, engaging young people in discussions on societal challenges. The project fosters stronger collaboration with policymakers and creates sustainable networks for knowledge-sharing. Key outputs include training curriculum, a two part practical guide for youth workers, a whitepaper for policymakers.
topics: Reaching the policy level/dialogue with decision makers

hr.name: Hrvatska edukacijska i razvojna mreza za evoluciju sporazumijevanja (HERMES)

2025-1-FR02-KA220-YOU-000365186.title: EcoQuest 2 – Games for environmental education
2025-1-FR02-KA220-YOU-000365186.summary:
<< Objectives >>

We aim to create a set of games and training resources to teach youth aged 16-25 about the environment and climate change, and how they can act in the EU, through the scope of GreenComp areas and competencies. The games will take the form of a video game and of an educational live role-playing game (LARP).

<< Implementation >>

Results:
- A guide on green competencies for youth
- 12 activity sheets on green competencies for youth (one for each green competence)
- A video game
- A LARP scenario with guidelines for implementation in multiple settings
- A manual for educators on how to implement game-based activities to teach green competencies 
- Testing activities involving at least 400 youngsters and feedback from 50 educators and specialists
- A project website with 16 OER

<< Results >>

This project aims to enhance youth's green competencies and environmental action skills, while supporting educators in teaching these competencies through game-based learning. Youth organizations will gain resources and training to implement inclusive environmental programs, fostering civic participation and critical thinking among youth. The focus is on increasing knowledge, supporting youth-led initiatives, and promoting inclusivity, particularly for marginalized groups.

2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000356166.title: No More Divided Societies (NM:S): Strengthening Youth-Led Inter-Ethnic Solidarities
2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000356166.summary:
<< Objectives >>

This project aims to connect key actors overcoming ethnic barriers through peer learning, knowledge exchange, and cross-border cooperation. It will build a sustainable network linking youth-led grassroots initiatives and academia to develop strategies for inter-ethnic cooperation. The project will also develop practical tools and policy recommendations as well as educate and empower youth to develop and lead effective conflict transformation and initiatives which foster inter-ethnic cooperation.

<< Implementation >>

Online Database: Mapping key actors in inter-ethnic cooperation.
Study Visits: Three cross-border knowledge-exchange visits. 
In-Depth Interviews: Identify challenges in youth work.
training of trainers: Equip youth with practical skills.
Artivist Action: Promote inclusive community engagement.
Handbook: Outline practical tools for youth workers.
Policy Brief: Develop policy recommendations.
Conference & Advocacy: Promote and discuss outputs.
Social Media Campaign: Raise awareness of project out

<< Results >>

The project will enhance inter-ethnic cooperation by connecting key actors and fostering cross-border collaboration. It will produce a Handbook with practical conflict transformation tools and a Policy Brief with recommendations for national and EU stakeholders. Trained youth workers will apply new skills, while stakeholder meetings, a conference, and advocacy efforts will promote policy adoption. A social media campaign will increase visibility and public engagement.
topics: Bridging intercultural, intergenerational and social divide
Reaching the policy level/dialogue with decision makers
Quality and innovation of youth work

2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000360604.title: My Encounter - Engaging Youth through MicroDemocracy Interventions
2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000360604.summary:
<< Objectives >>

My Encounter introduces a scalable, youth-driven model that fosters civic engagement and democratic participation of youth, empowering and supporting them to shape their communities through co-creation of microdemocratic interventions with youth workers. It enhances youth work quality and recognition by equipping youth workers with knowledge and practice to support youth, ensuring its long-term sustainability; and raises awareness of youth engagement’s role in building democratic societies.

<< Implementation >>

My Encounter directly engages over 300 young people, youth workers and stakeholders in the youth sector (including policymakers) by offering: training opportunities; developing digital tools; facilitating microdemocratic community interventions; providing mentor support; promoting examples of good practice; implementing research (focus groups, surveys, analyzis), campaigns and events to develop sustainable resources, fostering civic engagement and democratic participation of youth.

<< Results >>

My Encounter delivers the Vademecum handbook with 15 models of microdemocratic interventions, tested through 40 youth-led activities. A 3-day curriculum validated through summer school trains 12 youth workers and 12 youth. The digital platform ensures long-term access to resources and an online planning tool, while 2 social media campaigns promote participation. Policy report advocates for policy changes and final events connect youth, youth workers, and policymakers, ensuring long-term impact.
topics: Promotion of alternative forms of participation
Quality and innovation of youth work

2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000361087.title: Eco-patrols - Boost it`s Green Goals
2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000361087.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Project aims to enhance non-formal environmental education by scaling-up the EP method, integrating modern environmental concepts, and using digital tools to empower youth, youth workers, and organizations across the EU for a sustainable future; to boost local youth engagement in environmental initiatives and civic activism by expanding EP to various communities, building partners' capacities for long-term impact; to create a strong EP network of organizations committed to the Eco-patrol concept

<< Implementation >>

*EP=Eco-patrol
Develop extended EP manual; 
Upgrade the content and usages of Mobile eco-game;
Pilot EP program in 5 communities with 100youngsters;
Build capacity of 100 youth workers, educators and teachers for using the EP method;
Mentor and support trainers to implement 20 EP Modules;
Mentor and support EP groups in organization of 5 eco-actions 
Form the EP network;
Design the EP platform; 
Implement EP social network campaign;
Produce Transfer of knowledge, replication and networking plan;

<< Results >>

Results and outcomes: extended Eco-patrol manual, upgraded Mobile eco-game, practical environmental actions, Eco-patrol international network, Eco-patrol platform, Eco-patrol social media campaign, Transfer of knowledge, replication, and networking Plan, Policy recommendation plan, all of which will scale up the involved partners capacity for international collaboration and push the non-formal education for environment to the next level.

hr.name: Association for nature and environment conservation and sustainable development promotion Argonauta

2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000362567.title: MYTHOS – Myth-based Youth Treatment for Healing, Overcoming & Support
2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000362567.summary:
<< Objectives >>

We want to create a new structured treatment programme that will be aimed at helping adolescents and young adults to train their social skills, promote their mental health and combat xenophobia. The programme will be based on psychodrama and mythology and will also promote cultural heritage and connection to community. The programme will be short (10 sessions) and usable in diverse contexts. We also spread the programme and make adolescent and young adult group treatment more widely available.

<< Implementation >>

Project will consist of: 
-Capacity building exchanges between partner countries (3 exchanges with 12 participants)
-Creation of the Mythos programme and manual
-Creation of the supplementary materials: Book of myths and associative cards "Folklore"
-Adolescent and young adult Mythos groups (2 groups of at least 6 for each country, 60 participants in total)
-Education of experts (45 per country, 225 in total)
-Evaluation and revision of the programme
-Promotion and dissemination

<< Results >>

We expect that adolescents that go through the Mythos programme will have more developed social skills, more psychological resources for the challenges that they are facing through their development and more tolerant views, as well as a greater interest in their cultural heritage. We also expect that more experts, especially young experts, will gain new skills and tools for working with youth to make Mythos treatment more available for those who need it and create a more caring and community.
topics: New learning and teaching methods and approaches

2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000363188.title: Empowering Youth Participation through Digital Transformation
2025-1-HR01-KA220-YOU-000363188.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The aim of this project is to enhance youth engagement in local policy making by strengthening the capacities of at least 100 youth municipality officers and at least 100 youth council members for effective engagement of local young people in youth policy and governance, through the development of tailored digital learning tools (2 MOOCs) and through establishing an Advocacy Toolkit for further implementation of the MOOCs, within a 30-month timeframe.

<< Implementation >>

The project will develop a localized MOOC for municipality officers in Croatia, Italy, Cyprus, and Romania, tailored to national contexts, in collaboration with municipal representatives. A complementary MOOC for youth council members will focus on their role. National residential training sessions for both MOOCs will be organized. Advocacy follow-up activities based on the Advocacy Toolkit will be carried out, and project outcomes will be presented at multiplication events for greater impact an

<< Results >>

The project will result in:
= empowered and better-equipped municipality officers (at least 100) and youth council members (at least 100) that will engage local youth effectively in policy making and governance processes 
= innovative digital tools to enhance youth engagement in local democracy
= youth workers with new tools to support better youth participation in local contexts
= a more resilient, inclusive, and digitally competent ecosystem for youth participation in local policymaking.
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

2025-1-IE01-KA220-YOU-000355236.title: Multicultural Inclusion, Growth & Hope for Thriving Youth Online
2025-1-IE01-KA220-YOU-000355236.summary:
<< Objectives >>

MIGHTY YOU EU will develop a much-needed youth educational programme, raising capacities of youth workers and engaging diverse youth to become allies, and upskilling through this programme start standing up against online xenophobia. We want to help them build resilience, learn methods to treat, report and protect themselves online against online xenophobia.

We will
- map good practices
- engage & inspire target groups
- develop learning resources
- train target groups
- connect them long-term

<< Implementation >>

MIGHTY YOU EU will:
•	Develop a Digital Inclusion Toolkit to support educators in countering online xenophobia.
•	Create a classroom and digital course, delivered through an international training event.
•	Establish 5 Local Assemblies and a Digital HUB for youth engagement.
•	Ensure resources gain successors, active adoption in youth education, and get disseminated, reaching international audiences while grabbing local & national attention.

1.1. Project Management Handbook with strategies and guidelines
2.1. Digital Inclusion Toolkit with 30 best practices

SUCCESSORS IDENTIFIED,

ERASMSUS+ FUNDING PROGRAMME WIDELY POSITIVELY HIGHLIGTED.
topics: Reception and integration of refugees and migrants

2025-1-IT03-KA220-YOU-000350839.title: Green Advocacy for Nature’s Development and Learning Framework
2025-1-IT03-KA220-YOU-000350839.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The GANDALF Project fosters youth engagement in sustainable living, environmental awareness, and social entrepreneurship. Inspired by the harmonious lifestyles of Hobbits, Elves, and Ents, it develops innovative solutions promoting green technologies, community solidarity, and forest ecosystem protection. Through education, hands-on projects, and outreach, GANDALF cultivates active citizenship and equips young people with skills for environmental stewardship and social innovation.

<< Implementation >>

The GANDALF Project will implement interactive workshops, training sessions, and field studies on sustainable living, eco-friendly technology, and forest conservation. Activities include community garden creation, renewable energy innovation, recycling entrepreneurship, reforestation campaigns, and awareness programs. Digital platforms will disseminate results, while virtual seminars and local events will engage youth, educators, and policymakers for long-term impact.

<< Results >>

The GANDALF Project aims to produce practical guides, digital resources, and training materials on sustainability, eco-innovation, and forest conservation. Expected outcomes include community gardens, recycling prototypes, renewable energy solutions, reforestation initiatives, and youth-driven social entrepreneurship projects. A project website, awareness campaigns, and virtual seminars will ensure broad outreach, fostering long-term environmental impact and active citizenship.

2025-1-IT03-KA220-YOU-000351360.title: Digital Parents: Raising Children in a Onlife Age
2025-1-IT03-KA220-YOU-000351360.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The Digital Parents project aims to equip educational organizations with tools and resources to support parents in guiding their children through the onlife world. It strengthens educators' competencies in managing digital transition, engaging parents in the educational process, raising awareness of digital challenges impacting children and youth development, and promoting intergenerational learning between children, adolescents, and parents.

<< Implementation >>

After conducting desk research, the partnership develops guidelines for parent engagement and OERs (Open Educational Resources) for use in an Urban Game on media education. A transnational conference is organized to share recommendations with policymakers and stakeholders, while national multiplier events raise awareness of the importance of supporting adults in bridging the intergenerational gap in media literacy. This helps uphold the values of digital transition in a long-lasting way.

<< Results >>

The promotion of media education in an onlife and intergenerational perspective and with an intersectional and children rights based approach innovates the youth and education sector. The organisations effort toward digital transition in the education sector is supported by higher competences of Youth workers and parents and new findings and tools: a Desk research, a Guidelines document, a Digital manual on Urban Game about Media Education, OERs and recommendations to be shared at the EU level.
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work

2025-1-IT03-KA220-YOU-000363238.title: YES: Youth Engagement and Employability for Success through Social Entrepreneurship
2025-1-IT03-KA220-YOU-000363238.summary:
<< Objectives >>

YES intends driving social innovation, accelerating sustainability and positively impacting local, rural and urban communities, addressing youth depopulation, unemployment and climate change through a dynamic youth project aimed at empowering NEET and youth workers by equipping them with crucial and innovative soft skills intertwined at social entrepreneurial tools, in-person bootcamps, in order to enhance their competitiviness and resilience in the employment market.

<< Implementation >>

The main activities odf YES will be divided as follows:
WP1: Project Management
WP2: Needs analysis of Youth Workers and NEETs on their skills to be acquired to access quality training/labour market.
WP3: Development of the YES Training Programme consisting of two parts, one focusing on soft skills and one on social entrepreneurship.
WP4: YES-Up Programme, in-presence events enabling young NEETs and Youth Workers to practise their skills on social entrepreneurship. Promotion of YES results.

<< Results >>

YES project aims to achieve the following results:

Increased Awareness of Social Entrepreneurship and Soft Skills
Enhanced Soft Skills through Youth Engagement
Innovative Training Methodology Developed on relevant skills in the job market
In-Person YES Activities realised with Youth on Social Entrepreneurship
Fostering a greater understanding of volunteering principle among youth, enabling them to appreciate its transformative learning potential in their communities and to peers-to-peers.
topics: Overcoming skills mismatch and addressing the needs of the labour market

2025-1-IT03-KA220-YOU-000363907.title: FAIRY - Fostering AI with Rural Youth
2025-1-IT03-KA220-YOU-000363907.summary:
<< Objectives >>

1.Enhance 4 youth NGO from rural areas in applying AI tools increasing their visibility and event management
2.Boost AI empowerment through a reverse mentoring programme involving at least 30 young people and 30 YWs from 4 rural areas
3.Design a full open preparatory virtual training course on digital mentoring skills for educators and youth
4.Co-create 1 international and 12 local nature-based workshops to create a wellbeing Festival
5.Create an AI dashboards usability in rural area

<< Implementation >>

WP1 - Project management and kick-off meeting
WP2 - Research and Survey about IA in the rural areas
WP3 - Wellbeing Festival with young people and Youth Worker in rural area
WP4 - Local Actions
WP5 - Promotion and Dissemination of results and Final event in Spain with Press confernce

<< Results >>

Outputs
- AI survey and dashboard on risks, benefits and potential biases in rural communities
- Renewed digital strategy for each of the organization involved using at least 2 AI-powered tools
- Full preparatory online course for mentoring programme on digital and AI-powered tools. 
- Toolkit on digital and AI tools for organizations. The toolkit will include training material, resources and recommendations
topics: Tackling geographical remoteness and involving rural areas
Development of disadvantaged rural and urban areas

2025-1-PT02-KA220-YOU-000364028.title: Circular Food Economy: Reducing Waste and Carbon Footprint
2025-1-PT02-KA220-YOU-000364028.summary:
<< Objectives >>

CIRCFOOD objectives are focused on capacity building of partners through active participation of all partners in educational activities and development of educational materials, collecting and presenting the relevant data from youth sectors of participating countries, raising capacities of youth workers and youngsters through transnational and local events, online learning opportunities and dissemination campaigns; in the fields of sustainability, circular economy and food waste management.

<< Implementation >>

CIRCFOOD activities include comprehensive research on attitudes of youth and youth work sector approaches in dealing with the topics of sustainability, circular economy and food waste management, development of educational resources for youth workers and educators, implementing local and transitional trainings and edu sessions, developing web platform with online courses, and organising online campaigns and final conference with youth work stakeholders from participating countries.

<< Results >>

Major outcomes of CIRCFOOD will be visible in raised competences of 75 youth workers and 100 youngsters through in-person local and transitional activities, 150 youth workers and 300 youngsters through online learning opportunities; in the fields of sustainability, circular economy and food waste management. Project result include comprehensive research with good practices examples, 2 educational resources, online platform, 2 online learning courses and 5 online dissemination campaigns.
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work

hr.name: Domas, obrt za poduku, savjetovanje i poslovne usluge, vl. Domagoj Morić

2025-1-SK02-KA220-YOU-000356526.title: Resilient Europe
2025-1-SK02-KA220-YOU-000356526.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The Resilient Europe project combats polarisation by equipping educators, youth workers, and young people with practical tools for conflict transformation and civic resilience. It provides training, digital tools, animations, and youth-led initiatives to foster critical thinking, inclusive narratives, and cross-sector collaboration. Through education and engagement, it strengthens dialogue, democratic participation, and long-term resilience against societal divisions.

<< Implementation >>

The Resilient Europe project will implement capacity-building trainings for educators and youth workers, develop a Conflict Transformation Educators’ Guide, produce six Modern Challenges animated videos, six DARE to Care youth interview series, and create an interactive "What Can I Do?" digital tool. It will host international training event, webinars, and dissemination campaign, ensuring cross-sector collaboration and long-term accessibility of resources.

<< Results >>

We aim at directly empowering over 170 educators and youth workers from Slovakia, Croatia and Netherlands with conflict transformation skills and valuable and diverse resources to navigate polarised environments and provide these resources for further and broader audience. We are answering direct calls for such materials and trainings by the target groups in each country.

hr.name: Hrvatska edukacijska i razvojna mreza za evoluciju sporazumijevanja (HERMES)

2025-1-TR01-KA220-YOU-000361018.title: İklim Krizinin Gıda Güvenliğine Etkisi: Gençlik Krize Hazırlanıyor
2025-1-TR01-KA220-YOU-000361018.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The aim of our project is to enable young people to understand the impacts of the climate crisis on food security and to gain knowledge and skills in sustainable agricultural practices and social entrepreneurship. Along with this goal, it is aimed for the participants to develop sensitivity towards environmental issues and adopt active citizenship roles. It is aimed for young people to develop sustainable business models and engage in social responsibility projects.

<< Implementation >>

Training modules and seminars will be organized to provide information on climate crisis and food security issues. In addition, farm visits and practical workshops will be organized to experience sustainable agricultural practices. Participants will be offered social entrepreneurship trainings and encouraged to develop sustainable business models. Social responsibility projects will be implemented to raise community awareness and the information obtained will be shared
through reports.

<< Results >>

Among the expected outcomes of our project, first of all, it is envisaged that the knowledge levels of the participants on climate crisis and food security will increase significantly. In addition, it is aimed to turn the project ideas developed in the field of sustainable agricultural practices and social entrepreneurship into concrete outputs. Reports on the training processes, participant feedbacks and recommendations will be detailed and shared with relevant stakeholders.

2025-2-FR02-KA220-YOU-000387630.title: CiviLuanti
2025-2-FR02-KA220-YOU-000387630.summary:
<< Objectives >>

CiviLuanti aims to implicate youth populations in sustainable urban projects through the open source game generator Luanti. The project hopes to foster active citizenship while valorising the diversity of European territories. It will 1) train youth and educators to become agents of digital urban deliberation 2) inspire new forms of youth-centered civic participation 3) create more open and ecological game environments 4) federate Luanti communities around a clear and tested social agenda.

<< Implementation >>

CiviLuanti will develop digital services that integrate questions of ecological maintenance into gaming environments; generate a set of games that reflects the constraints of diverse territories; and plan and execute urban deliberative workshops – all of which will be documented through guides, audio-visual content, and papers. The project associates beneficiaries to each activity, making them co-designers of digital tools and practices, for a new form of action based digital education.

<< Results >>

CiviLuanti delivers a set of digital services that, through guides and demonstrators, can be adopted/adapted widely, and a network of facilitators and educators that will pursue urban deliberative processes. In the long-term, CiviLuanti forms an alternative model to techno-solutionism by situating both urban and digital development locally, supported by a new young workforce equipped to engage critically with our digitised world: the condition for a digitally sovereign Europe.
topics: Promotion of alternative forms of participation

hr.name: UDRUGA ZA PROMICANJE KVALITETE URBANOG ZIVOTA "URBANI SEPARE"

2025-2-NL02-KA220-YOU-000375729.title: NatureVR: Virtual pathways to youth well-being and environmental stewardship
2025-2-NL02-KA220-YOU-000375729.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project addresses the need for innovative, inclusive, and engaging tools to help youth workers improve youth well-being and environmental stewardship. It aims to equip youth workers in the Netherlands, Spain, Croatia, and Italy with VR tools that enhance nature intelligence (NQ), support mental and social well-being, and foster sustainability. The project will identify needs, co-develop VR tools, raise awareness, and influence policies for long-term impact.

<< Implementation >>

The project includes research, VR tool development, training, and advocacy. Under WP2, activities focus on needs assessments for young people and youth workers, a study on VR’s benefits and risks, and the definition of learning objectives. WP3 covers VR design, development, testing, and accessibility. WP4 includes training materials, ToT sessions, and e-learning modules. WP5 ensures dissemination and policy influence through social media, regional and national engagement, and final conferences.

<< Results >>

The project will equip youth workers in the Netherlands, Spain, Croatia, and Italy with inclusive and innovative VR tools to enhance nature intelligence, youth well-being, and sustainability. It will improve understanding of young people’s needs and youth workers’ capacities, create VR tools aligned with the NQ model, promote active use of VR in youth work, raise awareness among stakeholders, and positively influence policy discussions for broader adoption.

2025-2-NL02-KA220-YOU-000376479.title: Empowering unprivileged young people to become influential ecosocial voices through civic monitoring
2025-2-NL02-KA220-YOU-000376479.summary:
<< Objectives >>

ECOSOCIAL VOICES empowers 100 unprivileged youth to effectively influence the ecosocial transition (i.e., integrated ecological-social transformation) both locally and individually by introducing innovative civic monitoring practices. These practices intend to promote active youth engagement in assessing ecosocial challenges. By fostering a deeper understanding of their role, the project wants to encourage a more sustainable and socially responsible lifestyle in youth.

<< Implementation >>

Partners will develop an interactive intrapreneurial skills programme for unprivileged youth, set up youth-led civic monitoring groups and cycles, and host local valorisation forums with unprivileged youth, youth worker ambassadors and stakeholders. They will also create a hands-on guide on advanced civic monitoring, capacitate youth worker ambassadors at an EU bootcamp, deploy an online gateway to showcase results and ensure wide project promotion.

<< Results >>

ECOSOCIAL VOICES will deliver a microlearning programme for unprivileged youth, engaging 100 in civic monitoring groups and conduct cycles to identify and act on ecosocial issues, organise 15 local events to foster active youth citizenship, and draft policy recommendations on youth-led participatory approaches to ecosocial challenges. It will offer a hands-on guide and capacity building on civic monitoring for youth worker ambassadors, alongside a multilingual online gateway to share results.
topics: Promotion of alternative forms of participation
Reaching the policy level/dialogue with decision makers

2025-2-SK02-KA220-YOU-000381902.title: AflaGreen: Empowering Youth for a Sustainable Future
2025-2-SK02-KA220-YOU-000381902.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project breaks the cycle of fragmented, issue-based education by offering a holistic approach that equips youth with agency, financial literacy, digital skills, and green/social entrepreneurship competences. It empowers youth workers with innovative tools, drives youth-led action, and promotes inclusion and sustainability - preparing young people not just to cope with today’s crises, but to lead in shaping tomorrow’s solutions.

<< Implementation >>

We will boost youth skills and employability through national and international trainings, interactive workshops, youth-led projects, competitions, regular transnational meetings, and a final conference. These will be reinforced by a practical manual with a trainer toolkit, and online learning platform. Advocacy activities will ensure long-term impact through active stakeholder engagement, external presentations, and wide dissemination by all partners.

<< Results >>

The project will empower youth with employability, entrepreneurial mindset, financial, digital, and green skills, while building the capacity of youth workers through an innovative manual and online platform. Alongside youth-led projects, cross-border networks, inclusion, and sustainable practices, a strong advocacy component will amplify young voices, influence stakeholders, and promote policy change for long-term systemic impact.
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work

2026-1-BG01-KA220-YOU-000453632.title: Green Habits for Future Balkans
2026-1-BG01-KA220-YOU-000453632.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Develop and validate the Balkan Green Behaviour Model – an evidence-informed, practical framework to shift everyday green behaviours in small communities in Bulgaria, Croatia and Serbia. Train 75 young people (25/country) as Local Ambassadors to design and run 3 youth-led behaviour-change campaigns, and translate results into reusable tools, policy outputs and an open Online Resource Hub.

<< Implementation >>

We will implement 5 work packages: WP2 mapping and baseline (survey + 3 focus groups) in BG/HR/RS; WP3 co-creation of the model, training curriculum and Campaign Toolkit; WP4 three national pilots (2 workshops + 1 youth-led campaign per country) with pre/post measurement and evidence portfolios; WP5 comparative report, policy brief, Online Resource Hub and three national policy & community roundtables.

<< Results >>

Expected results: 1 Behaviour Model with indicators, 1 training curriculum and 1 Campaign Toolkit with visual identity; a comparable baseline dataset and needs report; 3 pilot portfolios with lessons learned; a 10–15 recommendation Policy Brief and at least 3 written follow-up commitments (one per country); an open Online Resource Hub (min. 500 visits); improved green leadership skills and intentions among participants.

hr.name: UDRUGA ZA ODRŽIVI DRUŠTVENI RAZVOJ I VOLONTERIZAM (ASSOCIATION FOR SUSTAINABLE SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT AND VOLUNTEERISM)

2026-1-BG01-KA220-YOU-000454901.title: "INCLUencers - Digital Youth Volunteering for Inclusive Communities"
2026-1-BG01-KA220-YOU-000454901.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project aims to strengthen inclusive youth volunteering through cross-border cooperation, digital innovation and mentoring. It seeks to enhance youth workers’ capacity to support inclusive volunteering, empower young people with digital, social and civic competences, and promote European values through a transnational digital platform enabling youth-led online campaigns for social inclusion.

<< Implementation >>

Main activities are:
-	Capacity Building for Youth Workers – to equip them with tools to engage and support inclusive youth volunteering
-	Empowering Youth Volunteers as INCLUencers – to provide youth volunteers with modern tools to reach, support, and inspire peers with fewer opportunities
-	INCLUencers Digital Platform– to provide a transnational digital space that enables youth-led action, strengthens mentoring and digital participation and supports inclusive youth volunteering across borders

<< Results >>

The main tangible results include:
-	A multilingual Youth Worker Toolkit for Inclusive Digital Volunteering (incl. curricula and methodologies)
-	A multilingual Youth Volunteer Training Package (incl. Volunteer training modules; Digital storytelling guides; Campaign templates)
-	A transnational digital platform serving as a collaborative space for youth volunteers - INCLUencers Digital Platform (with Video Studio; Campaign Hub; Volunteer library; Micro-Campaign Incubator)
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work
Promotion of alternative forms of participation

hr.name: UDRUGA ZA ODRŽIVI DRUŠTVENI RAZVOJ I VOLONTERIZAM (ASSOCIATION FOR SUSTAINABLE SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT AND VOLUNTEERISM)

2026-1-BG01-KA220-YOU-000455682.title: Next-Generation Accessibility Towards Unified Resources, Environment and Lifestyle for Youth
2026-1-BG01-KA220-YOU-000455682.summary:
<< Objectives >>

The project Next-Generation Accessibility Towards Unified Resources, Environment and Lifestyle for Youth aims to create an Europe-wide model for inclusive nature and environmental protection for young people with fewer opportunities featuring:inclusion,environmental conservation,youth engagement,and lasting impact—on the ground and online,reaching 6400 members of the youth community and experts of related fields across Bulgaria,Lithuania,Estonia,Croatia,Italy,Spain,Belgium and EU countries.

<< Implementation >>

To reach our goal we are developing NATURAL Methodology and EU-wide certification model based on in-depth research.Those are testes during 1 year Pilot Actions in the partnering countries leading to Youth Learning Exchange and the development of Policy Recommendation. We are creating digital resources,organizing webinars and online conference, building up the Youth Outdoor Portal/YOP/ platform. Finally,the project is spread out through EU BACK TO NATURE festival week and dissemination events.

<< Results >>

The NATURAL Methodology and EU-wide certification model for inclusion and accessibility for young people with fewer opportunities in outdoor activities and environmental protection efforts is supported by the international expert Council beyond the project.The YOP - www.outdoorportal.eu offers Research reports and Pilot action case study reports per partnering country,Policy recommendation, 42 Natural video stories,3 webinars,online conference,all project materials from the roll out events.
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work

2026-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000450770.title: Education Mosaic - linking the interface of formal and non-formal education
2026-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000450770.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Too many marginalized youths lack access to democratic and sustainability education because schools and non-formal programs fail to collaborate. Education Mosaic (EdMo) bridges this gap by connecting educators from both sectors and defining areas of strategic collaboration.  EdMo delivers up-to-date tools, study visits and trainings that enable educators across Europe to engage with their learners on controversial topics and imagine a European future that is democratic, sustainable and inclusive

<< Implementation >>

EdMo brings together expertise in civic and sustainability education, and youth empowerment from four EU countries. We develop specific offerings on bridging formal and non-formal education and to empower educators to address controversial issues. We create sustainability plans and develop policy papers for long-term integration and strategic alignment. A package of materials, skill development, capacity building, and institutional embedding qualifies educators and strengthens youth engagement.

<< Results >>

EdMo strengthens the capacity building and networking of non-formal educational institutions. EdMo will create a Toolbox with 8–10 inclusive learning offers and a Training Guide with study visit insights. Partners will award 12+ organizations the EdMo Good Practice Badge. The project will also deliver sustainability plans, a handbook on bridging the gap between formal and nonformal education, and policy papers to ensure long-term impact and strategic alignment of formal and non-formal learning.

2026-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000455880.title: Green & Inclusive Democracy – Youth Work for Sustainable and Just Communities
2026-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000455880.summary:
<< Objectives >>

To strengthen the quality and relevance of youth work by developing and validating a European competence framework for eco-democracy, inclusion and misinformation resilience. The project aims to create scalable, multilingual tools that enable youth work systems to foster structured, inclusive civic engagement and empowers youth workers as democratic multipliers, embedding structured, sustainable civic participation within youth work systems across diverse European contexts.

<< Implementation >>

We will co-develop & pilot a European Curriculum and multilingual 5-module MOOC for youth workers, create a validated Practical Toolkit, implement 8 National Green Democracy Labs as testing environments to validate methods, organise a transnational Youth Work Capacity Camp, conduct national policy dialogues, and disseminate open-access resources through Online Hub, multiplier events and European networks. We will meet for 3 in-person project coordination meetings & have monthly online meetings.

<< Results >>

validated Curriculum, multilingual MOOC & Practical Toolkit
≥80 youth workers trained
≥400 downloads of Toolkit, Curriculum, MOOC
≥100 users testing MOOC
≥160 youth engaged in Labs
32 youth workers in the Camp
≥200 youth (workers) engaged in My Green Vote campaign
≥12000 people reached through social media/campaign
≥176 participants on 4 multiplier events
≥2,000 unique visitors of the online hub
4 national policy briefs ensure institutional uptake
≥40 participants in national policy dialogue
topics: Creating new, innovative or joint curricula or courses

hr.name: Udruga za unaprjedenje suvremenih zivotnih vjestina Ostvarenje

2026-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000463566.title: Missionen für ein inklusives und zukunftfähiges Europa
2026-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000463566.summary:
<< Objectives >>

MIS Europe promotes the future skills of neurodivergent and socio-economically disadvantaged young people through storytelling-based learning formats, so-called missions. The aim of the project is to develop a format through the creation of high-quality, interlinked work packages that will strengthen youth education professionals in their work with the target group in the long term and support them in promoting future skills.

<< Implementation >>

At MIS Europe, several activities ensure the quality of the project and promote the development of innovative and high-quality project results. The activities are a combination of European cooperation and a local culture of testing and feedback. Four international Train-the-Partner activities strengthen the consortium and promote the development of results. Mission developments and training formats at the local level promote implementation and provide important insights.

<< Results >>

The project results developed in MIS Europe enable youth education professionals to promote future skills among neurodivergent and socio-economically disadvantaged young people. In successive work packages, project coordinators are first trained in the use of the storytelling-based learning format (missions), followed step by step by other professionals. All the results developed are compiled in a mission handbook.
topics: Quality and innovation of youth work

2026-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000466029.title: Democracy Remix: Youth Reclaiming Participation Through Creative Media
2026-1-DE04-KA220-YOU-000466029.summary:
<< Objectives >>

DemoRemix aims to reframe democratic participation as creative, accessible and youth-driven. The project will empower young people, especially those with fewer opportunities (NEETs, youth with disabilities and migrant youth), to express civic ideas through creative media. At the same time, it equips youth workers with innovative methods and digital tools to strengthen youth participation and dialogue with decision-makers across Europe.

<< Implementation >>

Partners from Germany, Serbia, Italy, Croatia and Austria will implement a training course for youth workers, develop a curriculum and e-learning course, organise local Democracy Remix Labs where young people design civic campaigns, host a transnational Hackathon, and create an Online Remix Hub and Toolkit. Public Democracy Remix Festivals and policy dialogue events will connect youth, organisations and decision-makers.

<< Results >>

The project will produce a Curriculum, Digital Toolkit, Online Remix Hub and an e-learning course for youth workers. At least 20 youth workers will be trained and 100 will complete the online course. Around 75 young people will design civic campaigns in 5 Democracy Remix Labs, reaching over 1000 peers. A Hackathon, 5 Festivals and a Policy Brief will strengthen youth participation and influence youth work practices across Europe.
topics: Reaching the policy level/dialogue with decision makers

hr.name: Udruga za unaprjedenje suvremenih zivotnih vjestina Ostvarenje

2026-1-EE01-KA220-YOU-000456001.title: Immersive Journeys into European Citizenship
2026-1-EE01-KA220-YOU-000456001.summary:
<< Objectives >>

EU360 aim to shift civic education from passive information to experiential learning through co-created XR scenarios. Strengthen civic agency, resilience, and ethical competences such as moral sensitivity, value-based reasoning, and perspective-taking among at least 360 young Europeans. Train 50 educators in XR facilitation and ensure zero-barrier access through a multilingual, hardware-agnostic WebXR framework.

<< Implementation >>

Conduct 5 co-creation workshops with 60 youth to design branching XR journeys. Develop an open-source, browser-based XR Suite with AI-assisted multilingual facilitation and virtual assets. Produce an "Immersive Civics" Handbook (OER) and video tutorials to train 50–60 youth workers in XR facilitation. Pilot the XR journeys with 360 youth and 50 educators across five countries to validate impact and issue Open Badges.

<< Results >>

A functional, multilingual EU-360 XR Suite for ethical competence development and a "Civic-Digital Gap Report" based on 300+ youth surveys. An OER Educator Toolkit, including a 50-page handbook and a troubleshooting wiki for autonomous implementation. Issuance of at least 360 Open Badges certifying acquired civic and digital competences. A Civic Impact Report with policy recommendations shared via six national multiplier events reaching over 270 stakeholders.

2026-1-EE01-KA220-YOU-000462981.title: Learn to Advocate for Youth Work – Exploring diverse and grounded advocacy resources
2026-1-EE01-KA220-YOU-000462981.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Increase the social and political recognition of youth work in Europe by strengthening youth work organisations’ advocacy capacities. We will generate evidence on public perceptions, develop and pilot an advocacy training programme, and implement a coordinated Year of Advocacy at national and EU level, supported by practical tools, strong dissemination and stakeholder engagement.

<< Implementation >>

Implement advocacy capacity building (training, mentoring, practitioners pool), conduct transnational research on public perceptions of youth work (incl. national fact sheets and Social Recognition Toolbox), run a coordinated Year of Advocacy with national and European advocacy plans and actions (stakeholder meetings, campaigns, policy engagement), and disseminate results via a resource hub, networks, and a European final conference.

<< Results >>

Strengthen the advocacy knowledge, skills and organisational capacities of youth work organisations; develop and pilot a practical advocacy training programme focused on youth work recognition; generate evidence on public perceptions of youth work and convert it into effective advocacy messages; implement a coordinated Year of Advocacy at national and EU levels; and increase the visibility, legitimacy and policy relevance of youth work through structured dissemination and stakeholder engagement
topics: Reaching the policy level/dialogue with decision makers

hr.name: NORMA Nacionalna organizacija radnica s mladima

2026-1-FR02-KA220-YOU-000457292.title: Climate & Mental Health: Equipping Youth Workers to Better Support Young People Facing Eco-Anxiety
2026-1-FR02-KA220-YOU-000457292.summary:
<< Objectives >>

Our project objectives are:
