2020-1-IT02-KA229-079044.title: SHARING MEMORABLE ADVENTURES AND RICH TRADITIONS
2020-1-IT02-KA229-079044.summary:
BACKGROUND
 The idea of the project was inspired by the desire to create an opportunity for our students to better understand the value of their culture heritages and give them sufficient knowledge on how to preserve these treasures and how to promote the sustainable tourism. 
 Cultural heritage represents our history, our connection to the past, present and future and contributes to maintaining or creating a regional, national and European identity. 
 The essence of the project is to let the students’ passion and enthusiasm run free, be creative, open their eyes around them and share ideas and renew tourism through the creation of innovative travel itineraries which offer memorable non-conventional holiday trips that allow people (tourists) to learn something new and to be exposed to a full picture of a place.       
 The international environment where students act, will help them to accept the diversity among other people and be aware of the cultural differences.
 OBJECTIVES:
 As the project falls under the focus of the development of the students' cultural and intercultural awareness, we have set the following objectives for them: 
 To recognize the values and significance of the cultural heritage, the landscape and the environment
 To increase the cultural and intercultural awareness of students, making them more knowledgeable about the history, geography, literature, customs and traditions of their own country and of the other European countries
 To recognize and protect the concrete and intangible cultural heritage
 To enhance social cohesion through sharing the same cultural heritage 
 To break stereotypes about other cultures, traditions and lifestyles
 To rise young people's environmental sensitization and awareness 
 To improve students’ English language proficiency
 To improve students’ ICT skills through the use of applications and online tools for presentations, activities, evaluation
 To improve students’ transferable skills – communication, research and analysis, team work, adaptability, organisation 
 To improve students’ motivation for learning and self-confidence 
 At the level of the institutions, our objectives are: 
 To improve the European dimension and international cooperation 
 To motivate teachers 
 To improve the communication and cooperation among all school actors 
 NUMBER AND PROFILE OF PARTICIPANTS
 The age profile of the students will vary from 15 to 19. The ones who will take part at the LTTAs, who will be 4 or 5, including students coming from a disadvantaged social and cultural environment, will share what they have learnt with their mates and work with them for the realization of the future tasks.
 DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES
 A training program on Cultural Heritage and Sustainable Tourism held by experts in Cultural assets, Science, Marketing, Computer Science and Tourism, will be offered to students, in order to make them more knowledgeable about the value of the European rich and diverse heritage and to underline the importance of its preservation. 
 The training course, including lectures, workshops and visits at sites of great historical and environmental interest, will be organized during the meetings in the various countries and will be structured as follows:
 1° LTTA: How to create a Digital Travel Guide
 2° LTTA: Historical-Artistic itinerary
 3° LTTA: Naturalistic Routes
 4° LTTA: Sustainable Tourism
 5° LTTA: Tourism services and facilities
 6° LTTA: Tourism Promotion
 METHODOLOGY
 The Training course and workshops will be planned by involving the greatest number of students. Concrete topics will be not only dealt with in a theoretical way,  but learning by doing will be predominant as the interaction and communication between students and experts play a very important role. Students’ involvement will be enhanced by encouraging them to ask questions, explore new ideas, be innovative and creative and have fun at the same time.Students will learn and work in international groups to achieve a common goal using cooperation skills such as sharing, turn-taking, encouraging others, discuss their interests and compare their opinions. Moreover, they will be encouraged to widely use ITC through web searches, use of softwares, applications, e-platforms, DropBox and Google Drive.
 RESULTS:
 - Project website
 - 6 Digital Travel Guides (one for each country) that include the following sections:
 A brief historical description of each country/area
 The main customs and traditions including myths and legends
 Two itineraries: a “Historical-Artistic journey” and a "Naturalistic route”
 - Promotion materials to promote the 6 European countries 
 - An international e-recipe booklet
 IMPACT
 This project will ensure that all learners appreciate the importance of the cultural heritage preservation and understand its great impact in term of economic benefits, job training and maintenance of craftsmanship skills, revival of city centers and heritage tourism.

2020-1-IT02-KA229-079079.title: Be True, Do not Bully!
2020-1-IT02-KA229-079079.summary:
The theme of our project was linked to the 2015 Paris Declaration. During surveys conducted at partner schools, students had been asked if they had ever been bullied. 28% of the students had answered "Yes". Moreover, 67% of school administrators and teachers had said they had tried to prevent bullying through various methods, but they hadn't seen the expected impact, especially long-term. 74% of them believed that education on proper behavior and self-protection against bullying was essential.

The project aimed to address several key issues regarding bullying and its prevention. We wanted to tackle the bullying problem at an international level, believing that sharing ideas and experiences would lead to more effective solutions. The "Be True, Do not Bully" (BTDB) project was designed under the Erasmus+ programme, with participation from five partner countries. The primary goal of BTDB was to merge anti-bullying activities with cultural elements, thereby amplifying their impact.

The objectives of our project were to reduce bullying at schools through teacher training, student, and parent activities, and pupil exchange programs. Thanks to LTTAs, teachers had strengthened their professional skills, students had participated actively, and participants have improved their language and ICT capabilities. They have learned about new cultures, traditions, and educational policies.

Besides LTTAs, during BTDB, there were local, virtual, dissemination, and sustainability activities to support our project. Concrete results, such as the creation of a digital guide about bullying, were expected to enhance the project's sustainability. Once all parts of schools have become aware of the problem and potential solutions, the issues related to bullying are expected to decrease. The BTDB project was aimed to help students become better future citizens.

In the changing world and the new age of education, our schools aim to improve the quality of education. For the 21st-century skills and competencies, in collaboration with partner schools, we conducted project activities to ensure all our students could be entrepreneurial, creative, and artistic, or to classify whether they succeeded, and to educate in an environment free from bullying and filled with friendship. We aimed to establish collaborative school environments for our teachers and students, create innovative spaces necessary for the use of ICTs where education can happen everywhere, teach how and where technology is, rather than fearing it, reduce peer bullying, and explain the consequences of bullying through the activities and mobility in our project. We collaborated to develop techniques that would allow our students to learn persistently and permanently, away from dull school environments. In the new age, we organized classroom settings to enable both our designed students and teachers to be innovative, creative, and have diverse perspectives. We prepared necessary materials, made plans, and aimed to improve quality by holding meetings and sessions for teacher and student training. We encouraged children's imagination to grow through activities designed to inspire students to use and learn from their own technologies.

2020-1-IT02-KA229-079127.title: Digitalised Schools
2020-1-IT02-KA229-079127.summary:
Improving the ICT skills and Key competences of their citizens in a Digital Era is one of the priorities of EU policies. As partners we also have the same aim and decided to carry out this Project "Digitalised Schools". "DS" is a Project consisting of 5 partners from Italy, Turkey, Potugal, North Macedonia and Croatia and aiming to strenghten and improve of participants' key competences on favoured ICT elements such as "html, coding, 3D, robotics and web 2.0 tools" and lead them to integrate those elements into curriculum in schools through lots of new Innovative methods to be executed during LTT, Virtual, Local and Dissemination activities.  "Digitalised Schools" also will help participants to meet new technology-based innovative teaching methods, to increase the capacity of each institution as a whole by observing in-situ training in Europe, to compare them with their own and they will make their own shortcomings and transfer them firstly to their students and their institutions. The subject of our project is basically based on how Institutions can keep pace with the New World that is rapidly globalizing by integrating basic ICT elements such as web2.0 tools, coding, 3D technology, html and Robotics with education. Our teachers and students will develop their personal and then institutional teaching and learning capacities with the achievements they have achieved through this project. The European Commission has moved the "new global conjuncture" previously mentioned in the Lisbon Strategy to a new strategy called "Europe 2020" for smart, sustainable, environmental and inclusive growth. The measures envisaged under the Lisbon Strategy to ensure a transition to a competitive and knowledge-based economy aim to accelerate the development of the information society and the establishment of the European Research Area for all citizens. It is important to increase the research and development investments of the European Union, especially in the public and private sectors, to invest in human resources and to encourage innovation in order to improve the scientific and technological infrastructure. It aims to increase the academic success of our students, develop teachers and transfer them to the institution, parents, other schools, develop human resources, and integrate scientific and technological developments into the field of education. As a result, our project coincides with both the EU 2020 vision and our partners' strategic vision. In addition, another aim of the project is to teach teachers how to develop their students' communication skills, organizational skills, self-expression and how to use body language correctly. In a sense, our goal is to equip teachers with the support and opportunities they need for continuous professional development, and to enable our Teachers to create valuable e-learning platforms by collecting valuable information on the favoured ICT elements.
 Thanks to this project
 *Each teacher will share, meet and implement the applications regarding with favoured ICT elements such as html, coding, 3D technology, Robotics and Web 2.0 tools in educational environments. 
 * By integrating European and world-class e-learning platforms such as Open Education Resources (OER) and Open Learning Environments (OEL) into their own teaching, it will be possible to renew teacher education activities and go to home education. system.
 * Participants will gain confidence in dealing with cultural and social differences by controlling their personal and professional qualities, adopting innovative and active pedagogies.
 * They will have a broader vision in understanding the educational systems, policies and practices of different countries.
 * Basic competences such as digital skills and critical thinking will be developed.
 * The overall trend in the European dimension will be pursued by capturing the quality of globalizing education by increasing the use of ICT in all stakeholders of the institution - staff, students, parents, other schools. 
 With this project, teachers will learn how to use web2.0 tools, html, coding, 3D and robotics by meeting their professional development needs. They will help students to use their homeworks, project or visual work which they have done with those favoured elements. They will also transfer their competencies to their students. In terms of their management competence, the teachers will improve the institutional capacity as well as the development of the their English in European dimension and they will recognize different cultures, communicate with them, improve their communication skills and the development of the vision of Europe will be the plus point for them. The transfer of innovative educational understanding among the institutions, we will have an opportunity to observe the European Union concept of "all equality" and‘ all different’ in place. The Project will also be executed in etwinning platform "https://live.etwinning.net/projects/project/219086".

2020-1-IT02-KA229-079330.title: INNOVATIVE, CREATIVE, DIGITAL EDUCATION
2020-1-IT02-KA229-079330.summary:
With regard to education within the scope of the main initiative of the EU 2020, which puts education on the basis of development policies; The 4 main objectives of the 2020 Education and Training in the EU Council Concluding Declaration on Strategic Framework for Cooperation in Education and Training:
 • Lifelong Learning and realization of mobility,
 • Improving the quality and efficiency of education and training,
 • Ensuring equality, social solidarity and active citizenship,
 • At every stage of Education and Training, it was decided to promote creativity and innovation, including entrepreneurship.
 In line with these strategic objectives, it is recommended that member countries develop cooperation in these areas and increase their international capacities and share ideas, practices and methods. In line with the project's purpose and scope, we want to produce concrete outputs and to expand their results taking into consideration the needs of our institutions as follows;
 • Contribute to the innovation movement, thus adding a touch of creativity to teaching and having some concrete ideas on how to implement innovative strategies.
 • To improve the quality of education and training by carrying out strong social activities for teachers and students in-school and out-of-school to raise awareness by raising school culture to a higher level than the existing one
 • To adopt and apply methods and techniques to increase the motivation of students in the student-centered education system so that they can come to school willingly.
 • To accept the existence of digital media (especially young people are densely interested in) in every field of life and to use them in the most efficient way
 • To have creative methods and technics making difference
 • To create a practical educational environment to prepare the student for the future
 • To support interactive and project-based learning
 • To obtain different methods of using web-2 tools and design
 • To learn the examples of creating creative and innovative environments from each partner countries that have achieved success in education and to integrate them into our education
 The main purpose of our project is to have a creative education area forming innovative methods and technics and to increase the quality of education and to provide cultural dialogue by cooperating with European countries to raise cultural, innovative, creative and productive individuals in the employment in the future. Besides to make learning interesting, attractive, exciting, efficient and effective on behalf of teachers and students, features such as creativity in education, innovativeness, use of contemporary methods and approaches, digitalization are continuously emphasized concepts, all of these qualities to be converted to product transformation from theory to application is required. At this point, we will produce solutions to how this transformation happens, what it covers and what kind of products should be emphasized.
 Also, the result of our work will be to develop intercultural competence, increasing motivation to learn, especially foreign languages, an incentive for self-improvement, improvement of ICT skills, create a sense of community across barriers - the attitude of tolerance, respect for diversity of all kinds, of European culture, develop the ability to discuss, exchange views with people of a different worldview while creating products of our project. The project activities will be attended by 15 students and 12 teachers. In the implementation of activities we will use various methods: brainstorming, metaplan, lecture, problem solving method in the search for solutions to the problems addressed by the project; exposing method (film, exposition, demonstration combined with experience); debate (the aim will be to encourage children to a deeper knowledge of problems, learning communication skills and decision-making); educational games: simulation, decision making, psychological; practical classes, sporting activities.
 Materials developed in the project will be made available to teachers of partner schools and put to use in these schools. Our products will also be made available to other local and regional schools. Teachers, students will be invited to participate in workshops where they learn how to use the materials prepared during the project. The activities initiated during the international cooperation will be continued during the implementation of projects on similar subjects at the local and international level for the future (Erasmus+K229, K201 and Etwinning projects).

2020-1-IT02-KA229-079334.title: A HERITAGE FOR EACH COUNTRY, A EUROPE FOR EVERYONE
2020-1-IT02-KA229-079334.summary:
We are 5 European schools which want to join our efforts to increase the students’ knowledge and interest in subjects related to the cultural heritage of our countries – Geography, History. Moreover, in a world touched by globalisation in which individuals have a tendency to overlook their own national heritage, we need our students to go back to their own roots by knowing the customs and traditions which have been passed on from generation to generation. We are of the opinion that if you don’t know your roots, you don’t know your foundation and if you don’t know your foundation, you can never thrive. Therefore, we want to cultivate our students’ patriotic feelings, making them look back to their past and their origins, while at the same time opening their horizons to other cultures and their specificities. 
 PARTICIPANTS
 Students – the target group is made up of approximately 1000 students aged 12-14, 100 of them having special education needs. 150-200 of them will be selected as members of the work group (minimum 30 / country, but the number may vary according to the size of the target group up to 40). They will be at the core of our project, will be involved in the activities of preparation before the exchanges, 100 of them will participate in the activities during exchanges, will disseminate the information to the other members of the target group after the exchanges. 
 Accompanying teachers – 2 teachers/country/exchange. One of them will be the coordinator, while the other one will be a History/Geography/Literature/Arts/IT teacher
 OBJECTIVES
 The main purpose of the project is to increase the cultural and intercultural awareness of all the actors involved in its implementation. However, being specifically targeted to students, we have set the following objectives for them:
 OS1. To increase the cultural awareness of at least 80% of students, making them more knowledgeable about the history, geography, literature, customs, traditions, dances, music
 OS2. To increase intercultural awareness and competence of all the students, making them more knowledgeable about the other European countries, history, geography, literature, customs, traditions, dances, music.
 OS3 To improve students’ ICT skills by having them use mobile applications and online tools for presentations, activities, evaluation, creation of outputs
 OS4 To improve students’ transferrable skills – communication, research and analysis, team work, adaptability, organisation
 OS5 To improve students’ motivation for learning and self-confidence
 
 At the level of the institutions, our objectives are:
 1.To improve the European dimension and international cooperation
 2.To motivate teachers
 3.To improve the communication and cooperation among all school actors
 
 MAIN ACTIVITIES
 We plan to organize 5 exchanges, each dedicated and hosted by each partner:
 1. C1 - The Italian heritage – hosted by Italy in February 2021
 2. C2 – The Croatian Heritage – hosted by HR in May 2021
 3. C3 – The Romanian Heritage – October 2021
 4. C4 – The Turkish Heritage – March 2022
 5. C5 – The Portuguese Heritage – June 2022
 
 RESULTS
 Tangible results include: presentations created by students (30), workshop materials, online brochures (5), the final output “The European heritage”, guest students’ travel journals (80), the eTwinning space, eTwinning forum, photo albums (5), Europass mobility documents (112), certificates of attendance (112) initial and final evaluation forms, mobility documents (agenda, methodology, questionnaires, evaluation forms) etc. 
 IMPACT
 The institutions will benefit from the good practices acquired and transferred through the participation of students and teachers in the exchanges. They will promote intercultural learning and will open to new models that will benefit the students in the medium and long run, too.
 We will develop the European dimension of the school and will be better prepared to manage projects under the Erasmus+ programme – both the experienced schools and the less experienced ones. This project will lay the foundation for future cooperation among schools through eTwinning and Erasmus+.
